normal.desc: 【職場文法】David ___ an engineer at a tech company in Taipei.
normal.explain: 主詞 David 為單數第三人稱，現在式 be 動詞應使用 is。(B) are 用於複數或 you；(C) am 僅用於 I；(D) be 為原形動詞，在此不可直接作為主要動詞。

normal.desc: 【生活介系詞】I usually meet my friends for coffee ___ Saturday mornings.
normal.explain: 特定某一天的早晨或星期幾前面介系詞須用 on。(A) at 用於精確鐘點；(C) in 用於一般的 in the morning 或月份年份；(D) to 表示方向或目的地。

normal.desc: 【職場文法】Our team members ___ in the office from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. every day.
normal.explain: 主詞 Our team members 為複數名詞，現在簡單式動詞用原形 work。(A) works 用於單數第三人稱；(B) working 缺少 be 動詞不能作主要動詞；(D) is work 文法結構錯誤且 be 動詞與複數不合。

normal.desc: 【旅遊字彙】Excuse me, where can I buy a train ___ to Taichung?
normal.explain: 買火車「票」應使用 ticket。(A) menu 菜單；(B) passport 護照；(C) bill 帳單。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】Sarah loves animals. She ___ a cute dog and two cats.
normal.explain: 主詞 She 是單數第三人稱，have 的第三人稱單數現在式形式為 has。(B) have 用於複數或 I/you；(C) having 缺少 be 動詞；(D) 英語無 haves 這個字形。

normal.desc: 【日常對話】A: What is your favorite season? B: I like spring ___ the weather is warm and nice.
normal.explain: 後句是喜歡春天的原因，表原因的連接詞用 because。(A) but 表轉折；(C) so 表結果；(D) or 表或者選擇。

normal.desc: 【職場介系詞】The department meeting starts ___ 2:30 p.m. in room 402.
normal.explain: 具體鐘點時間前介系詞用 at。(A) on 用於星期或特定日期；(B) in 用於月份、季節、年份；(D) of 表所有格或部分關係。

normal.desc: 【旅遊文法】Look at the map! ___ two famous night markets near our hotel.
normal.explain: 表示「有」且後方主詞 two famous night markets 為複數名詞，應用 There are。(A)、(C) 英語中不可用 there has/have 表存在；(B) There is 用於單數名詞。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】This is not my laptop. ___ laptop is on the desk by the window.
normal.explain: 修飾名詞 laptop 需要用所有格形容詞 My。(B) Me 是受格；(C) I 是主格；(D) Mine 是所有格代名詞，後面不接名詞。

normal.desc: 【職場字彙】Please send me an ___ with the project report before Friday.
normal.explain: 寄送專案報告通常透過「電子郵件」email。(A) airport 機場；(C) umbrella 雨傘；(D) envelope 實體信封，常與實體信件搭配且與寄送專案報告語境不符。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】Ken doesn't drink coffee. He ___ hot tea every morning.
normal.explain: 主詞 He 為單數第三人稱，現在簡單式肯定句動詞字尾加 -s 成為 drinks。(B) drink 為原形動詞；(C) drinking 缺少助動詞；(D) to drink 為不定詞。

normal.desc: 【旅遊文法】The museum is closed today, so visitors ___ enter the building.
normal.explain: 因博物館今天休館，故參觀者「無法/不能」進入，填 cannot。(A) can 能夠，與前文語意矛盾；(C) are enter 文法結構錯誤；(D) 助動詞 must 後接原形動詞，不可加 to。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】A: Do you and your brother cook dinner on weekends? B: No, we don't. We usually ___ dinner at a restaurant near our home.
normal.explain: 主詞 We 為第一人稱複數，現在簡單式動詞用原形 eat。(B) eats 用於第三人稱單數；(C) eating 缺少 be 動詞；(D) are eat 文法結構錯誤。

normal.desc: 【職場對話】A: Good morning, Mr. Lin. Is this your jacket? B: No, it isn't. That is Peter's jacket, and ___ is over there on the chair.
normal.explain: 此處需要所有格代名詞 mine 代替 my jacket 作為後句的主詞。(A) he 是主格人稱代名詞；(C) my 是所有格形容詞，後面必須接名詞；(D) me 是受格代名詞。

normal.desc: 【旅遊介系詞】A: When do we arrive in Tokyo? B: The airplane lands ___ 4:00 p.m. ___ Friday afternoon.
normal.explain: 具體時間點 4:00 p.m. 前用 at；特定日期的下午 Friday afternoon 前用 on。(A)、(B)、(D) 的介系詞搭配皆不正確。

normal.desc: 【日常對話】A: Excuse me, ___ can I get to the nearest convenience store? B: Just walk straight for two minutes. It is next to the bank.
normal.explain: 詢問前往某處的方法或路線，使用疑問詞 how。(A) who 問人；(C) why 問原因；(D) what 問事物。

normal.desc: 【職場文法】Ms. Wang is very busy today. She ___ many business emails and reports to finish before leaving.
normal.explain: 主詞 Ms. Wang 為單數第三人稱，表示「擁有/有」使用 has。(B) have 用於複數主詞；(C) 表示擁有時 have 為狀態動詞，通常不用現在進行式；(D) does have 在無強調語氣的陳述中不自然且 A 選項最直接正確。

normal.desc: 【生活字彙】A: I want to make a fruit salad for the party tonight. B: Great! Let's go to the ___ to buy some fresh apples and bananas.
normal.explain: 購買蘋果與香蕉等食材應去超市 supermarket。(A) library 圖書館；(B) hospital 醫院；(D) hotel 飯店。

normal.desc: 【旅遊文法】A: Can we take pictures inside the art museum? B: No, visitors ___ take pictures here. It is not allowed.
normal.explain: 回答問句 Can we... 的否定句，表示不被允許或不能，使用 cannot (或 can't)。(A) don't 後面接原形但對應 can 的問句應使用情態助詞；(B) aren't 為 be 動詞無法直接修飾動詞 take；(D) can 與後文 not allowed 語意相反。

normal.desc: 【職場對話】A: What time ___ the new manager arrive at the company? B: She usually arrives at 8:45 every morning.
normal.explain: 主詞 the new manager 為第三人稱單數，一般動詞 arrive 的現在簡單式疑問句應使用助動詞 does。(A) do 用於複數或 I/you；(C) is 後面不可直接接一般動詞原形 arrive；(D) are 為複數 be 動詞。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】Tom is a doctor. He works in a big hospital, and ___ wife works in a school as an English teacher.
normal.explain: 先行詞 Tom 為男性，對應的男性單數所有格形容詞為 his。(B) her 為女性所有格；(C) its 為非人所有格；(D) their 為複數所有格。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Office Notice] Please turn off the lights and air conditioners before you leave the meeting room. Also, remember to take your cups and pens with you. Thank you for your help.
Q: What should workers do before leaving the room?
normal.explain: 告示第一句明白寫道「Please turn off the lights...」，因此選 B。(A)、(C)、(D) 內容皆未在告示中提及。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Kevin! I am at the café across from the train station. The coffee here is great and they have free Wi-Fi. What time will you arrive?
Q: Where is the writer right now?
normal.explain: 文中第二句「I am at the café across from the train station.」直接指出作者目前在咖啡廳。(A) 在火車上；(B) 在機場；(D) 在家，均與短文不符。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Restaurant Menu Note] Lunch Special: Monday to Friday, 11:30 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. All pasta dishes come with a free cup of black tea or green tea.
Q: What can a customer get for free with pasta on Wednesday at noon?
normal.explain: 週三中午屬於週一到週五的商業午餐時段，點義大利麵送一杯免費的紅茶或綠茶 (a free cup of black tea or green tea)，故選 D。(A)、(B)、(C) 皆不是隨餐附送的項目。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Hotel Information] Welcome to Sun Hotel. Breakfast is from 7:00 to 9:30 on the second floor. The swimming pool on the roof is open every day from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.
Q: Where can guests have breakfast in the morning?
normal.explain: 文中提及「Breakfast is from 7:00 to 9:30 on the second floor.」，早餐在二樓供應。(B) 屋頂是游泳池；(C)、(D) 與內文不符。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Email to Team] Dear all, our client from Japan will visit our office at 10:00 a.m. tomorrow. Please wear formal clothes and prepare the new product pictures.
Q: Why should the workers dress formally tomorrow?
normal.explain: 信中提到「our client from Japan will visit our office at 10:00 a.m. tomorrow」，因此大家需要穿著正式服裝接見客戶。(A) 考試；(C) 節日；(D) 派對，皆與信件原因不符。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Store Announcement] Fresh Bakery is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. every day except Sunday. We have fresh bread every morning and delicious cakes in the afternoon.
Q: On which day is Fresh Bakery closed?
normal.explain: 文中明確說明「except Sunday」（除了週日以外），代表週日公休。(A)、(B)、(D) 皆為正常營業日。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Travel Card Note] You can use this travel card for the MRT, city buses, and local trains. You can add money to your card at any convenience store or MRT station.
Q: Where CANNOT you add money to this card according to the note?
normal.explain: 文中僅列出便利商店與捷運站可以加值，沒有提到醫院 (hospital)，因此醫院是無法加值的地方。(A)、(B)、(D) 皆符合文中提及的地點。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Amy, I cannot go to the gym with you tonight. I have a bad headache, so I want to go to bed early. Let's exercise together next week.
Q: Why does the writer cancel the gym plan?
options: B. The writer is working late.
C. The writer lost a gym card.
normal.explain: 作者提到「I have a bad headache」（頭很痛），說明生病不舒服是取消運動的原因。(B) 加班；(C) 遺失會員卡；(D) 正在旅行，皆與內文不符。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Sign at the Library] Quiet, please! Do not talk loudly on your mobile phone in the reading area. If you need to make a call, please walk outside to the garden.
Q: What should people do if they need to speak on the phone?
options: B. Stay in the reading room.
normal.explain: 告示最後一句指出「If you need to make a call, please walk outside to the garden.」，因此應前往花園。(B) 留在閱覽室違反規定；(C)、(D) 不是文中所指示的行動。

normal.desc: 【職場文法】My supervisor ___ two languages: English and Japanese.
normal.explain: 主詞 My supervisor 是單數第三人稱，現在簡單式動詞字尾加 -s 寫作 speaks。(B) speak 用於複數或 I/you；(C) is speak 文法錯誤；(D) speaking 缺少助動詞。

normal.desc: 【生活介系詞】My family usually visits my grandparents in Tainan ___ October.
normal.explain: 月份（如 October）前面介系詞習慣使用 in。(A) on 用於具體日期或星期；(C) at 用於精確鐘點；(D) to 表示方向。

normal.desc: 【旅遊文法】Look at the street sign. You ___ turn left here because it is a one-way street.
normal.explain: 因是單行道（one-way street），此處表示禁止或「不能」左轉，用 cannot。(A) can 能夠，與單行道情境矛盾；(B) must 後面不接 to；(D) are not 無法直接修飾動詞原形 turn。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】This isn't Susan's bag. ___ bag is black, but this one is brown.
normal.explain: 修飾名詞 bag 需要使用所有格形容詞 Her。(A) She 是主格；(B) Hers 是所有格代名詞，後方不可直接加名詞；(C) Him 是男性受格代名詞。

normal.desc: 【旅遊字彙】Please have your passport and boarding ___ ready before you enter the gate.
normal.explain: 機場登機證的標準固定搭配是 boarding pass。(B) card 不與 boarding 組合成登機證；(C) boarding ticket 非標準用法；(D) bill 帳單。

normal.desc: 【日常對話】A: ___ do you go to work every morning? B: I usually take the MRT.
normal.explain: 根據回答「搭乘捷運」，可知提問在詢問交通方式或手段，使用疑問詞 How。(A) What 問事物；(C) Where 問地點；(D) Who 問人。

normal.desc: 【職場介系詞】Please put the printed contract ___ the manager's desk before 5 p.m.
normal.explain: 放置在桌面上，表面接觸的介系詞使用 on。(A) in 是在抽屜或物體內部；(B) at 表點；(D) to 表方向。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】___ a new supermarket near my apartment, so shopping is very convenient.
normal.explain: 表示某地存在某物，且後方主詞 a new supermarket 為單數，使用 There is。(A) It has 表主詞自身擁有，非客觀存在；(B) There have 文法錯誤；(C) There are 用於複數名詞。

normal.desc: 【日常對話】A: Is that blue water bottle ___? B: Yes, it is mine! Thank you for finding it.
normal.explain: 此處需要所有格代名詞 yours 代替 your water bottle 作為形容詞或補語結尾。(B) your 是所有格形容詞，後面必須接名詞；(C) you 是主格/受格；(D) yourself 是反身代名詞。

normal.desc: 【職場對話】A: When does the video conference start? B: It begins ___ 10:30 a.m. ___ Monday morning.
normal.explain: 具體時間點 10:30 a.m. 前用 at；特定日期的早晨 Monday morning 前用 on。(A)、(C)、(D) 介系詞搭配均不正確。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】My parents ___ coffee in the evening because it keeps them awake all night.
normal.explain: 主詞 My parents 為複數名詞，現在簡單式動詞否定句應使用 don't + 原形動詞 drink。(A) doesn't 用於單數第三人稱；(B) isn't 為單數 be 動詞且時態不符習慣性敘述；(D) not drink 缺乏助動詞。

normal.desc: 【旅遊對話】A: Excuse me, ___ a post office around here? B: Yes, walk straight and it is on your left.
normal.explain: 詢問單數名詞 a post office 是否存在，疑問句需倒裝為 Is there...?(A) are there 用於複數名詞；(B) 英語無 has there 句型；(C) there is 為肯定句語序。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Office Notice] The second-floor coffee machine is broken today. The repair person will fix it tomorrow morning. In the meantime, please use the machine in the break room on the fourth floor.
Q: Where can employees get coffee today?
options: C. At a convenience store outside.
normal.explain: 告示說明二樓咖啡機故障，臨時方案是「please use the machine in the break room on the fourth floor」（請使用四樓休息室的機器）。(B) 二樓咖啡機壞了；(C)、(D) 未提及。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Leo, I am still in a client meeting. It will end around 6:30 p.m. Can we meet for dinner at 7:00 at the noodle shop near our company?
Q: Why does the sender want to meet at 7:00 instead of earlier?
options: A. The noodle shop opens at 7:00.
B. The client meeting ends around 6:30.
C. The sender is stuck in traffic.
D. The sender is feeling sick.
normal.explain: 簡訊提到「I am still in a client meeting. It will end around 6:30 p.m.」，客戶會議到 6:30 才結束，因此改約 7:00。(A)、(C)、(D) 與簡訊內容不符。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Restaurant Menu] Daily Lunch Set (11:00-14:00): Chicken sandwich with fries and a cup of black coffee for $150. Add $20 to change your black coffee to hot milk tea or orange juice.
Q: How much is the sandwich set if you change the coffee to orange juice?
normal.explain: 套餐原價 150 元，換柳橙汁需加價 20 元（Add $20），總計 150 + 20 = $170。(A)、(B)、(D) 計算皆錯誤。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Bus Timetable Note] Bus Route 5: Bus arrives every 15 minutes on weekdays. On weekends and national holidays, the bus runs once every 30 minutes from 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.
Q: How often does Route 5 run on Sunday afternoon?
normal.explain: 週日屬於週末（weekends），文中明確指出「On weekends... the bus runs once every 30 minutes」，因此為每 30 分鐘一班。(B) 是平日班距；(A)、(C) 與文意不合。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Kyoto] Dear Helen, Greetings from Japan! The weather here is cool and sunny. We visited two old temples yesterday and took hundreds of photos. Tomorrow we are taking a bullet train to Osaka. Best, Mark.
Q: Where will Mark go tomorrow?
normal.explain: 明信片中寫道「Tomorrow we are taking a bullet train to Osaka.」（明天我們要搭新幹線去大阪），故選 A。(B)、(C)、(D) 皆與文末計畫不符。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Hotel Reception Sign] Breakfast is served from 6:30 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. in the dining room on the 1st floor. If you need early check-out before 6:00 a.m., please inform the front desk tonight.
Q: What should guests do if they want to check out at 5:30 tomorrow morning?
options: B. Tell the front desk tonight.
C. Leave the key inside the room.
normal.explain: 文中說明如果需要在早上六點前退房（early check-out before 6:00 a.m.），請「inform the front desk tonight」（今晚告知櫃檯），故選 B。(A)、(C)、(D) 均非告示所列要求。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Company Memo] To all staff: The building elevator will be inspected this Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. During this time, the elevator will stop working. Please use the stairs if you come to the office.
Q: What should people use to go upstairs on Saturday morning?
normal.explain: 文中提到電梯停用期間「Please use the stairs if you come to the office.」（請走樓梯），故選 C。(D) 電梯停工中；(A)、(B) 均屬不合邏輯且文內未指示之選項。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Tina, our boss said we have to hand in the sales report by 11:30 a.m. today. I am almost done with my part. Can you send me your sales numbers in ten minutes?
Q: What does the writer need from Tina?
normal.explain: 文中問句明確寫出「Can you send me your sales numbers in ten minutes?」，需要的是業務數字，故選 D。(A)、(B)、(C) 皆不是對方索取的項目。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Café Board] Today's Special: Buy any large hot drink and get a chocolate donut for only $10. Offer valid until 12:00 noon. Cash and Line Pay only.
Q: Which is true about the special offer?
options: B. You can pay by credit card.
C. Customers get a free donut.
D. It is for cold drinks only.
normal.explain: 文中提到「Offer valid until 12:00 noon.」（優惠有效至中午十二點止），因此 A 正確。(B) 僅收現金與 Line Pay；(C) 甜甜圈需加價 10 元並非免費；(D) 是買大杯熱飲 (large hot drink)。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Flight Schedule Screen] Flight CI100 to Tokyo Narita: Gate B4. Status: Delayed. Scheduled Departure: 08:50. New Departure: 10:10. Please stay near Gate B4 for updates.
Q: What is the new departure time for Flight CI100?
normal.explain: 螢幕資訊顯示「New Departure: 10:10」，因此新出發時間為 10:10。(A) 是原定時間；(C) 是登機門編號干擾項；(D) 未提及。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Notice at Fitness Center] Clean towels are available at the front counter. Please put used towels into the blue bin next to the shower room after you finish exercising. Thank you for keeping our gym clean.
Q: Where should members put their towels after exercising?
normal.explain: 文中指出「put used towels into the blue bin next to the shower room」，毛巾用完應放入藍色收集桶。(A)、(D) 未提及；(B) 櫃檯是領取乾淨毛巾的地方。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Kenting] Hi Jack, Kenting is amazing! We are staying at a small hotel near the beach. Every morning we go swimming, and in the evening we eat seafood at the night market. See you next Monday! Emily.
Q: What does Emily do in Kenting in the evening?
options: A. She swims in the sea.
D. She eats at the night market.
normal.explain: 文中提到「in the evening we eat seafood at the night market」，傍晚在夜市吃海鮮，故選 D。(A) 是早上的活動；(B)、(C) 文中均未提及。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Supermarket Receipt Note] Thank you for shopping at WellMart! Spend over $500 today to get a $50 discount coupon for your next visit. The coupon is valid until November 30.
Q: What can a customer get by spending more than $500 today?
normal.explain: 收據註記載明「Spend over $500 today to get a $50 discount coupon...」，可獲得 50 元折價券，選 A。(B)、(C)、(D) 均不符合文意。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Museum Ticket Notice] General admission: $200. Senior citizens (over 65) and students with ID: $100. Children under 6: Free admission. Audio guide rental: $50 per person.
Q: How much does a university student with a valid ID pay to enter?
normal.explain: 學生出示學生證（students with ID）票價為 $100，故選 B。(A) 是 6 歲以下幼童；(C) 價格未列出；(D) 是全票成人價。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Ben, the train from Hsinchu is 20 minutes late due to heavy rain. I will probably arrive at Taipei Main Station around 7:40 p.m. You don't need to wait for me for dinner.
Q: Why is the train delayed?
options: A. Bad traffic on the road.
D. A problem with the tickets.
normal.explain: 簡訊開頭寫道「due to heavy rain」（由於大雨），故誤點原因選 C。(A) 這是火車非公路交通；(B)、(D) 文中均未提及。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Office Sign] Welcome to the New Media Department. All visitors must register at the reception desk on the 1st floor and get a guest badge before going up to the 5th floor.
Q: What must a visitor get on the 1st floor before going upstairs?
normal.explain: 告示最後指明訪客必須「get a guest badge before going up」（取得訪客證證件），故選 D。(A)、(B)、(C) 文中皆未提及。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Menu at Green Bowl] Salad Options: Classic Caesar Salad ($120), Tuna Salad ($140), Chicken Salad ($160). Dressing choices: Italian, Ranch, or Thousand Island. Bread is included with all salads.
Q: What comes with every salad for free?
normal.explain: 菜單末句指出「Bread is included with all salads.」（所有沙拉均附麵包），故選 A。(B)、(C)、(D) 皆非隨餐附送項目。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Notice in Hotel Room] Dear Guest: Our hotel cares about nature. If you want us to change your bedsheets and towels, please put this green card on your bed before 10:00 a.m. Otherwise, we will not change them today.
Q: What should a guest do if they want fresh bedsheets?
options: A. Call the front desk at noon.
B. Put the green card on the bed.
C. Bring bedsheets to the lobby.
D. Wash them in the bathroom.
normal.explain: 說明提到「please put this green card on your bed before 10:00 a.m.」，想換床單需將綠色卡片放在床上，故選 B。(A)、(C)、(D) 皆不符合內文規定。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：雨；下雨
normal.explain: 口說表達「RAIN」(n.)：雨；下雨。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：星期日
normal.explain: 口說表達「SUNDAY」(n.)：星期日。例句：I visit my parents on Sunday.（我星期日去拜訪父母。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：火車
normal.explain: 口說表達「TRAIN」(n.)：火車。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：廚房
normal.explain: 口說表達「KITCHEN」(n.)：廚房。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：窗戶
normal.explain: 口說表達「WINDOW」(n.)：窗戶。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：肩膀
normal.explain: 口說表達「SHOULDER」(n.)：肩膀。例句：He tapped me on the shoulder.（他拍了拍我的肩膀。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：手指
normal.explain: 口說表達「FINGER」(n.)：手指。例句：I hurt my finger.（我弄傷了手指。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：護理師
normal.explain: 口說表達「NURSE」(n.)：護理師。例句：The nurse helps the doctor.（護士協助醫生。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：廚師；煮飯
normal.explain: 口說表達「COOK」(v.)：廚師；煮飯。例句：I cook rice every night.（我每天晚上煮飯。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：網球
normal.explain: 口說表達「TENNIS」(n.)：網球。例句：We play tennis on Saturday.（我們星期六打網球。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：音樂
normal.explain: 口說表達「MUSIC」(n.)：音樂。例句：Do you like pop music?（你喜歡流行音樂嗎？）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：相機
normal.explain: 口說表達「CAMERA」(n.)：相機。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：夾克；外套
normal.explain: 口說表達「JACKET」(n.)：夾克；外套。例句：Put on your warm jacket.（穿上你保暖的夾克。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：菜單
normal.explain: 口說表達「MENU」(n.)：菜單。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：三明治
normal.explain: 口說表達「SANDWICH」(n.)：三明治。例句：I ate an egg sandwich.（我吃了一個蛋三明治。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：天氣晴朗
normal.explain: 口說表達「SUNNY DAY」(phr.)：天氣晴朗。

normal.desc: 請唸出：週末愉快
normal.explain: 口說表達「HAVE A GOOD WEEKEND」(phr.)：週末愉快。

normal.desc: 請唸出：搭乘公車
normal.explain: 口說表達「TAKE THE BUS」(phr.)：搭乘公車。

normal.desc: 請唸出：捷運站
normal.explain: 口說表達「METRO STATION」(phr.)：捷運站。

normal.desc: 請唸出：客廳
normal.explain: 口說表達「LIVING ROOM」(phr.)：客廳。

normal.desc: 請唸出：洗手
normal.explain: 口說表達「WASH YOUR HANDS」(phr.)：洗手。

normal.desc: 請唸出：去慢跑
normal.explain: 口說表達「GO JOGGING」(phr.)：去慢跑。

normal.desc: 請唸出：聽音樂
normal.explain: 口說表達「LISTEN TO MUSIC」(phr.)：聽音樂。

normal.desc: 請唸出：試穿
normal.explain: 口說表達「TRY IT ON」(phr.)：試穿。

normal.desc: 請唸出：現金付款
normal.explain: 口說表達「PAY IN CASH」(phr.)：現金付款。

normal.desc: 請唸出：熱綠茶
normal.explain: 口說表達「HOT GREEN TEA」(phr.)：熱綠茶。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：今天天氣很熱。
normal.explain: 口說表達「IT IS HOT TODAY」(phr.)：請唸出短句：今天天氣很熱。。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：現在幾點了？
normal.explain: 口說表達「WHAT TIME IS IT」(phr.)：請唸出短句：現在幾點了？。

normal.desc: 【學校文法】Our teacher ___ in the classroom before 8:00 every morning.
normal.explain: 主詞 Our teacher 是單數第三人稱，現在式 be 動詞應選 is。(B) are 用於複數或 you；(C) am 搭配主詞 I；(D) be 為動詞原形。

normal.desc: 【家庭文法】My uncle lives in Tainan, and he ___ our family twice a month.
normal.explain: 主詞 he 為第三人稱單數，現在簡單式動詞字尾須加 -s 寫作 visits。(A) visit 為原形；(C) visiting 缺少助動詞；(D) is visit 結構錯誤。

normal.desc: 【天氣字彙】The sky is gray and full of clouds today. It is very ___.
normal.explain: 天空烏雲密布（full of clouds）代表陰天多雲，形容詞為 cloudy。(A) hot 炎熱的；(B) warm 溫暖的；(D) dry 乾燥的。

normal.desc: 【商店字彙】Excuse me, can I have the paper ___ to check the price of each item?
normal.explain: 購物結帳後核對商品金額的明細紙條是「收據/發票」receipt。(A) ticket 票券；(B) menu 菜單；(C) envelope 信封。

normal.desc: 【假日文法】Lisa is very musical. She ___ play the piano and guitar.
normal.explain: 助動詞 can 表能力，後接動詞原形且字尾不可變化。(B) cans 助動詞無第三人稱變化；(C) is can 雙助動詞文法錯誤；(D) can 後不可加 to。

normal.desc: 【家庭文法】This isn't my coat. ___ coat is hanging behind the bedroom door.
normal.explain: 修飾名詞 coat 需要所有格形容詞 My。(A) Me 為受格；(B) Mine 為所有格代名詞，後方不可接名詞；(D) I 為主格。

normal.desc: 【職場介系詞】Please put the finished report ___ the conference table before noon.
normal.explain: 放在會議桌面上，表平面接觸介系詞使用 on。(A) at 表特定點；(B) in 表內部；(D) to 表方向目的地。

normal.desc: 【學校對話】A: ___ is sitting next to Tom today? B: It is our new classmate, Jason.
normal.explain: 根據回答「新同學 Jason」，可知在詢問坐在旁邊的「人是誰」，疑問詞選 Who。(A) Where 問地點；(B) What 問事物；(C) How 問方式。

normal.desc: 【商店文法】These blue trousers are too long for me. Do you have a smaller ___?
normal.explain: 褲子長度太長需要詢問更小的「尺寸」size。(B) piece 通常不與 trousers 搭配（量詞應為 pair，但此處若要選號碼則直接用 size）；(C) colors 複數名詞與 a 衝突；(D) price 價格。

normal.desc: 【職場對話】A: What time does the weekly team meeting end? B: It usually finishes ___ 11:30 a.m. ___ Thursday.
normal.explain: 具體時間點 11:30 a.m. 前介系詞用 at；星期幾 Thursday 前用 on。(A)、(C)、(D) 介系詞搭配錯誤。

normal.desc: 【家庭文法】My brothers are very athletic, but they ___ like watching football on TV.
normal.explain: 主詞 they 是複數代名詞，現在簡單式一般動詞 like 的否定句須搭配助動詞 don't。(A) doesn't 用於第三人稱單數；(B)、(D) be 動詞不可直接修飾原形動詞 like。

normal.desc: 【學校對話】A: Excuse me, ___ any computer labs in this building? B: Yes, there are two on the third floor.
normal.explain: 修飾複數名詞 computer labs 的存在性疑問句，應將 be 動詞倒裝為 Are there...?(A) is there 用於單數名詞；(B) 無此文法結構；(C) there are 為肯定句語序。

normal.desc: 【天氣文法】It is ___ outside right now. Let's stay in the living room and watch movies.
normal.explain: be 動詞 is 後面需要形容詞作主詞補語，表天氣狀態選 rainy。(A) rain 為名詞/動詞；(C) rains 為動詞單數現在式；(D) rained 為過去式。

normal.desc: 【假日文法】Look at the park bench! Peter is sitting there with ___ dog.
normal.explain: 修飾後方名詞 dog，需要男性單數所有格形容詞 his。(A) him 為受格；(C) he 為主格；(D) himself 為反身代名詞。

normal.desc: 【職場對話】A: Can you print these files for the manager? B: Sorry, I ___ do it right now because the printer is out of paper.
normal.explain: 後文說明印表機缺紙（out of paper），且回答 Sorry，表示「無法/不能」列印，使用 cannot。(A) can 與後文矛盾；(B) am 無法直接接原形動詞 do；(D) 對應 Can you 問句否定應回答 cannot。

normal.desc: 【日常對話】A: This cake looks delicious! Did you make it yourself? B: Yes! Cooking is my favorite weekend ___.
normal.explain: 烹飪是個人喜愛的週末「嗜好/興趣」，名詞選 hobby。(A) price 價格；(B) problem 問題；(C) weather 天氣。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[School Notice] English Speaking Club meets every Tuesday at 4:30 p.m. in Room 204. Please bring your student ID and a notebook. Everyone is welcome to join!
Q: Where does the English Speaking Club meet?
normal.explain: 公告清楚註記「in Room 204」，故聚會地點選 A。(B)、(C) 文中未提及；(D) 430 為時間 4:30 的數字干擾項。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Office Text Message] Hi Claire, Mr. Evans called this morning. He rescheduled the client meeting from 2:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. Please prepare the presentation slides before 4:00 p.m.
Q: What time does the client meeting start now?
normal.explain: 簡訊提到會議時間改動「rescheduled the client meeting from 2:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m.」，現在開始時間為 4:30 p.m.，故選 B。(A) 原定時間；(C) 簡報準備截止時間；(D) 未提及。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Supermarket Special Board] Fresh Strawberries: Buy one box for $120, get the second box for half price! Offer valid this Saturday and Sunday only.
Q: How much are two boxes of fresh strawberries on Sunday?
normal.explain: 第一盒 120 元，第二盒半價為 60 元，兩盒總計 120 + 60 = 180 元，故選 C。(A)、(B)、(D) 計算不符合優惠說明。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Weather Board] Taipei Weather Today: Morning: Sunny, 26°C. Afternoon: Sudden heavy rain and thunderstorms, 22°C. Evening: Windy and cool, 19°C.
Q: When are thunderstorms expected today?
normal.explain: 資訊板顯示「Afternoon: Sudden heavy rain and thunderstorms」，午後有雷雨，故選 D。(A) 晴天；(C) 有風且涼爽；(B) 未列出。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Community Center Poster] Weekend Pottery Class: Learn to make your own coffee cups! Every Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00. All clay and tools are included in the fee.
Q: What do students make in this Saturday class?
normal.explain: 海報載明「Learn to make your own coffee cups!」（學習製作自己的咖啡杯），故選 A。(B)、(C)、(D) 皆非陶藝課製作成品。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Hsinchu] Dear Tina, we visited a strawberry farm in Guanxi this morning! We picked a big basket of fresh fruit and tasted sweet jam. Tomorrow we are visiting the old street. Love, Emily.
Q: What did Emily do on the farm this morning?
normal.explain: 明信片開頭說明拜訪草莓農場，並提到「picked a big basket of fresh fruit」（採了一大籃新鮮水果），故選 B。(A)、(C)、(D) 文中均未提及。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Bakery Sign] Today's Bake: Warm garlic bread comes out of the oven at 11:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. Limit of three loaves per customer. Cash and EasyCard accepted.
Q: How many loaves of garlic bread can one customer buy at most?
normal.explain: 告示指明「Limit of three loaves per customer」（每位顧客限購三條），故選 C。(A)、(B)、(D) 與限額不符。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Office Kitchen Notice] Please wash all spoons, mugs, and plates immediately after eating. Do not leave dirty items in the sink overnight. The cleaning team clears the sink every day at 6:00 p.m.
Q: What should employees do with their dirty mugs after using them?
options: A. Leave them in the sink.
B. Put them on the floor.
normal.explain: 告示第 1 句指示「Please wash all spoons, mugs, and plates immediately after eating」，必須立刻清洗，故選 D。(A)、(B)、(C) 皆違反規定。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Text Message Chain] Mike: 'Hi Sarah, are you coming to lunch with us?' Sarah: 'I have to finish checking this invoice for the boss. Can you bring a tuna sandwich back for me?' Mike: 'Sure, no problem.'
Q: What does Sarah want Mike to bring for her?
normal.explain: Sarah 詢問「Can you bring a tuna sandwich back for me?」，需要的是鮪魚三明治，故選 A。(B)、(C) 未提及；(D) invoice 是她在辦公室要檢查的文件。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[School Swimming Pool Rules] Swimming Pool Hours: Monday-Friday 06:00-21:00. Saturday 08:00-18:00. All swimmers must wear a swimming cap and shower before entering the pool.
Q: What must everyone wear in the pool?
normal.explain: 泳池規定「All swimmers must wear a swimming cap」（所有泳客必須戴泳帽），故選 B。(A)、(C)、(D) 皆不符合泳池著裝規定。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Holiday Hiking Note] Mountain Trail Info: Trail length is 3.5 km. Most hikers finish in two hours. Please stay on the marked path and carry at least 1 liter of drinking water.
Q: How much drinking water should a hiker carry at least?
normal.explain: 注意須知末句提醒「carry at least 1 liter of drinking water」（至少攜帶 1 公升飲用水），故選 C。(A)、(B)、(D) 數值不符。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Restaurant Daily Special] Thursday Dinner Special: Order any main steak and get a bowl of pumpkin soup and garlic bread for free! Service charge of 10% is included.
Q: What food is free with a main steak on Thursday?
options: B. A cup of black tea.
D. Pumpkin soup and garlic bread.
normal.explain: 優惠說明「get a bowl of pumpkin soup and garlic bread for free」，贈送南瓜濃湯與大蒜麵包，選 D。(A)、(B)、(C) 皆非免費贈品。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Notice on School Door] Science Lab 1 is closed for floor painting today and tomorrow. All chemistry classes are moved to Lab 3 across the hallway.
Q: Where are the chemistry classes held today?
normal.explain: 告示說明 1 號實驗室粉刷關閉，化學課「are moved to Lab 3 across the hallway」（移至走廊對面的 3 號實驗室），故選 A。(B) 今日關閉；(C)、(D) 未提及。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Apartment Notice] Elevators A and B will stop from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. this Wednesday for scheduled safety checks. Residents can take the emergency stairs near the lobby.
Q: How can residents go upstairs on Wednesday at 3:00 p.m.?
normal.explain: 電梯檢修期間（2:00-4:00 p.m.），住戶可走緊急樓梯「take the emergency stairs near the lobby」，故選 B。(A) 電梯暫停；(C) 不合理；(D) 4:00 p.m. 就恢復無須等到週四。

normal.desc: 【家庭文法】My sister and I ___ dinner with our parents every Sunday evening.
normal.explain: 主詞 My sister and I 為第一人稱複數（相當於 we），現在簡單式動詞使用原形 have。(B) has 用於單數第三人稱；(C) having 缺乏助動詞不能作主要動詞；(D) is have 文法結構錯誤且與複數主詞不合。

normal.desc: 【學校介系詞】Our English class begins ___ 7:00 p.m. every Tuesday.
normal.explain: 具體鐘點時間（7:00 p.m.）前介系詞一律使用 at。(A) on 用於星期或特定日期；(C) in 用於月份或年份；(D) for 表示一段時間持續長度。

normal.desc: 【天氣字彙】It is very ___ today, and the streets are wet. Take an umbrella with you.
normal.explain: 街道是濕的（the streets are wet），又要帶傘，可知天氣是下雨的 rainy。(A) sunny 晴朗的；(B) hot 炎熱的；(D) quiet 安靜的。

normal.desc: 【商店文法】Excuse me, how much ___ these red apples?
normal.explain: 主詞 these red apples 為複數名詞，詢問價錢時 be 動詞需使用 are。(A) is 用於單數名詞；(B) be 為動詞原形；(C) am 僅搭配主詞 I。

normal.desc: 【假日文法】My brother ___ swim very well, but he cannot ride a bicycle.
normal.explain: 情態助動詞 can 無論主詞是第幾人稱形式皆不變，後接動詞原形。(B) 助動詞不可加 -s；(C) 助動詞前不可加 be 動詞；(D) 助動詞前不可加 to。

normal.desc: 【職場字彙】Please print this file and put it in the blue ___ on the shelf.
normal.explain: 列印出來的文件檔案應存放在「資料夾」folder 裡。(A) bottle 瓶子；(C) pillow 枕頭；(D) mirror 鏡子。

normal.desc: 【日常對話】A: ___ bag is this on the classroom chair? B: It belongs to our teacher, Mr. Chen.
normal.explain: 詢問物品「是誰的」所有權，疑問詞使用 Whose。(A) Who 問人；(B) Where 問地點；(D) Why 問原因。

normal.desc: 【家庭文法】Ken is my best friend, and ___ father is a doctor at the city hospital.
normal.explain: 先行詞 Ken 為男性單數，對應的所有格形容詞為 his。(A) her 為女性所有格；(B) their 為複數所有格；(C) your 為第二人稱所有格。

normal.desc: 【學校對話】A: Do you know the answer to Question 5? B: No, I don't. Let's ___ the teacher for help.
normal.explain: 祈使句提議句型「Let's」後面必須接動詞原形，故選 ask。(B) asks 為第三人稱單數式；(C) asking 為動名詞/現在分詞；(D) to ask 為不定詞。

normal.desc: 【職場文法】Mr. Lin does not work on weekends. He always ___ his family to the park on Saturdays.
normal.explain: 主詞 He 是單數第三人稱，頻率副詞 always 後的現在簡單式動詞字尾加 -s 寫作 takes。(A) take 為原形；(C) taking 缺少助動詞；(D) is take 文法錯誤。

normal.desc: 【天氣介系詞】It is usually cold and dry in northern Taiwan ___ winter.
normal.explain: 季節（如 winter、summer）前面介系詞習慣使用 in。(A) at 用於精確時間點；(B) on 用於特定日期或星期；(D) of 表所屬關係。

normal.desc: 【商店對話】A: May I try on this coat? B: Yes, of course. The fitting room is ___ the corner over there.
normal.explain: 表示位置在「轉角處/轉角過去」，英語常用 around the corner。(A) between 需兩者之間 (between A and B)；(B) under 在…下方；(C) into 表進入動態。

normal.desc: 【假日文法】Look at the park lawn! ___ many children playing football together.
normal.explain: 主詞 many children 為複數名詞，表示客觀存在應使用 There are。(B) There is 用於單數；(C)、(D) 英語不可用 there have/has 表存在。

normal.desc: 【生活對話】A: What do you usually do after dinner? B: I usually listen to music, and my sister ___ her favorite book.
normal.explain: 主詞 my sister 為單數第三人稱，敘述日常習慣用現在簡單式，動詞加 -s 寫作 reads。(A) read 為原形；(C) reading 缺少 be 動詞；(D) is read 結構錯誤。

normal.desc: 【職場對話】A: Why is Eric not at his desk? B: He is ill today, so he ___ come to work.
normal.explain: 因為 Eric 生病了（He is ill），所以「不能/無法」來上班，情態助動詞用 cannot。(A) is 不能直接加原形 come；(B) can 能，與前文語意矛盾；(D) does 為肯定助動詞不合語境。

normal.desc: 【商店文法】These black shoes are too small for me. Can I look at ___ pairs over there?
normal.explain: 修飾遠處 (over there) 且為複數的名詞 pairs，指示代名詞應使用 those。(A) this 為單數且指近處；(B) that 為單數；(C) much 修飾不可數名詞。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[School Notice] Dear Students, the school library will close early at 4:00 p.m. this Friday for book cleaning. Please return all borrowed books to the front desk before 3:30 p.m.
Q: What time must students return their books this Friday?
normal.explain: 告示明確指出「Please return all borrowed books to the front desk before 3:30 p.m.」，因此還書截止時間是 3:30 p.m. 前。(B) 是圖書館閉館時間；(C)、(D) 未提及。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Weather Forecast] Weather in Kaohsiung tomorrow: Sunny and hot with temperatures around 32°C. There is no rain expected all day. Please drink plenty of water when outdoors.
Q: What is the weather like in Kaohsiung tomorrow?
normal.explain: 預報第一句寫明「Sunny and hot with temperatures around 32°C」，故選 B。(A)、(C)、(D) 與預報完全不符。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Mom, the company meeting will finish late tonight. I cannot join the family dinner at 6:30. Please don't wait for me and eat first.
Q: Why will the sender miss the family dinner?
options: A. The sender is buying groceries.
B. The sender missed the bus.
C. The company meeting finishes late.
D. The sender wants to watch a movie.
normal.explain: 簡訊開頭解釋「the company meeting will finish late tonight」（公司會議今晚會很晚結束），故選 C。(A)、(B)、(D) 皆非簡訊所述原因。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Store Opening Sign] Welcome to Green Bookshop! Opening Hours: Monday to Saturday from 10:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. Closed on Sundays and national holidays.
Q: On which day is Green Bookshop closed?
normal.explain: 告示末句清楚說明「Closed on Sundays and national holidays」（週日與國定假日公休），故選 D。(A)、(B)、(C) 均為正常營業日。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Holiday Activity Poster] Weekend Art Workshop: Learn to paint flowers this Saturday from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. Fee: $300 per person. All brushes and paper are provided for free.
Q: What is provided for free at the workshop?
normal.explain: 海報末句載明「All brushes and paper are provided for free.」（畫筆與畫紙全部免費提供），故選 A。(B)、(C)、(D) 未提及。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Yilan] Dear Grandma, we are having a wonderful holiday in Yilan! Yesterday we visited a tea farm, and today we went to the hot springs. The air here is very fresh. Love, Penny.
Q: Where did Penny go today?
normal.explain: 明信片提到「today we went to the hot springs」（今天去了溫泉），故選 B。(A) 茶園是昨天的行程；(C)、(D) 文中未提及。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Office Notice] Please remember to lock the front door if you are the last person to leave the office in the evening. Also, make sure all lights are switched off.
Q: What should the last worker do before leaving?
normal.explain: 告示指出「remember to lock the front door if you are the last person to leave」，最後離開者必須鎖大門，故選 C。(A)、(B)、(D) 文中皆未要求。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Bakery Discount Note] Buy two loaves of toast after 7:00 p.m. and get a carton of fresh milk for half price! This special discount is available every evening while supplies last.
Q: What item is half price after 7:00 p.m. when buying two loaves of toast?
options: D. A carton of fresh milk.
normal.explain: 告示說明「get a carton of fresh milk for half price」（鮮奶半價），故選 D。(A)、(B)、(C) 皆不是打折品項。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi David, do you want to play badminton at the sports center this Saturday morning? We have four people now and we need one more player. Let me know today!
Q: How many players do they have right now?
normal.explain: 簡訊提到「We have four people now and we need one more player.」（現在有四個人，還差一位），因此目前有 4 人，選 A。(B)、(C)、(D) 皆不符合原文數字。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[School Classroom Rules] 1. Arrive in class before 8:10 a.m. 2. Put mobile phones into your bags during lessons. 3. Raise your hand before you ask a question.
Q: What should students do with their mobile phones during lessons?
options: A. Put them on the desks.
B. Put them into their bags.
C. Give them to the teacher.
D. Keep them in their pockets.
normal.explain: 規則第 2 條指明「Put mobile phones into your bags during lessons」，上課時需將手機放進包包，故選 B。(A)、(C)、(D) 與班規不符。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Weather Warning Note] Weather Warning: A strong typhoon is coming tomorrow. All schools and office buildings in the city will be closed. Please stay inside your home safely.
Q: What should people in the city do tomorrow?
normal.explain: 警報文末提醒「Please stay inside your home safely.」（請安全待在家中），故選 C。(A) 商店非安全場所；(B)、(D) 學校與辦公室均關閉停課停班。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Clothing Store Sign] Season Clearance Sale: All summer shirts and shorts are 30% off! Sale ends this Sunday. No refunds or exchanges for sale items.
Q: What can a customer NOT do with the items bought on sale?
options: B. Try them on in the store.
normal.explain: 告示最後一句特別說明「No refunds or exchanges for sale items」（特價品不退不換），因此不能退換貨，選 D。(A)、(B)、(C) 皆不是被禁止的項目。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Taitung] Dear Andy, Taitung is very quiet and beautiful. We stayed at a small farm yesterday and drank fresh milk. Tomorrow morning we plan to ride bicycles along the forest path. Best regards, Grace.
Q: What did Grace drink at the farm yesterday?
normal.explain: 明信片寫道「We stayed at a small farm yesterday and drank fresh milk.」，因此昨天喝的是鮮奶，選 A。(B)、(C)、(D) 均未在文中提及。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Supermarket Member Notice] VIP Member Day is every Wednesday. Members get 10 bonus points for every $100 spent. Points can be used as cash on your next visit.
Q: On which day can members earn bonus points?
normal.explain: 通知首句指明「VIP Member Day is every Wednesday.」（會員日為每週三），故選 B。(A)、(C)、(D) 皆不是會員日。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：走路；散步
normal.explain: 口說表達「WALK」(n.)：走路；散步。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：交談；說話
normal.explain: 口說表達「TALK」(v.)：交談；說話。例句：I need to talk to you.（我需要和你談談。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：帶來；拿來
normal.explain: 口說表達「BRING」(v.)：帶來；拿來。例句：Please bring your umbrella today.（今天請帶你的雨傘。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：需要
normal.explain: 口說表達「NEED」(v.)：需要。例句：I need a pen to write.（我需要一枝筆來寫字。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：展示；表演
normal.explain: 口說表達「SHOW」(v.)：展示；表演。例句：Show me your ticket please.（請出示你的票券。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：星期一
normal.explain: 口說表達「MONDAY」(n.)：星期一。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：星期四
normal.explain: 口說表達「THURSDAY」(n.)：星期四。例句：We have a test on Thursday.（我們星期四有測驗。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：十三
normal.explain: 口說表達「THIRTEEN」(num.)：十三。例句：My daughter is thirteen years old.（我女兒十三歲。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：四十
normal.explain: 口說表達「FORTY」(num.)：四十。例句：He drives for forty minutes to work.（他開車四十分鐘去上班。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：八十
normal.explain: 口說表達「EIGHTY」(num.)：八十。例句：My grandfather is eighty this year.（我祖父今年八十歲。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：走過街角
normal.explain: 口說表達「AROUND THE CORNER」(phr.)：走過街角。例句：The entrance is around the corner.（入口轉過街角就到。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：在二樓
normal.explain: 口說表達「ON THE SECOND FLOOR」(phr.)：在二樓。

normal.desc: 請唸出：過馬路
normal.explain: 口說表達「CROSS THE STREET」(phr.)：過馬路。

normal.desc: 請唸出：點餐
normal.explain: 口說表達「ORDER FOOD」(phr.)：點餐。

normal.desc: 請唸出：冰水
normal.explain: 口說表達「ICE WATER」(phr.)：冰水。

normal.desc: 請唸出：熱湯

normal.desc: 請唸出：只是看看
normal.explain: 口說表達「JUST LOOKING」(phr.)：只是看看。

normal.desc: 請唸出：買一送一
normal.explain: 口說表達「BUY ONE GET ONE」(phr.)：買一送一。

normal.desc: 請唸出：太小了
normal.explain: 口說表達「TOO SMALL」(phr.)：太小了。

normal.desc: 請唸出：太大了
normal.explain: 口說表達「TOO BIG」(phr.)：太大了。

normal.desc: 請唸出：很高興見到你
normal.explain: 口說表達「GLAD TO MEET YOU」(phr.)：很高興見到你。

normal.desc: 請唸出：我的榮幸
normal.explain: 口說表達「MY PLEASURE」(phr.)：我的榮幸。

normal.desc: 請唸出：沒關係
normal.explain: 口說表達「NEVER MIND」(phr.)：沒關係。

normal.desc: 請唸出：星期一見
normal.explain: 口說表達「SEE YOU MONDAY」(phr.)：星期一見。

normal.desc: 請唸出：這星期五
normal.explain: 口說表達「THIS FRIDAY」(phr.)：這星期五。

normal.desc: 請唸出：請進來
normal.explain: 口說表達「COME IN PLEASE」(phr.)：請進來。

normal.desc: 請唸出：請坐下
normal.explain: 口說表達「SIT DOWN PLEASE」(phr.)：請坐下。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：我叫艾美。
normal.explain: 口說表達「MY NAME IS AMY」(phr.)：請唸出短句：我叫艾美。。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：我住在台中。
normal.explain: 口說表達「I LIVE IN TAICHUNG」(phr.)：請唸出短句：我住在台中。。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：我是個上班族。
normal.explain: 口說表達「I WORK IN AN OFFICE」(phr.)：請唸出短句：我是個上班族。。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：我今年四十歲。
normal.explain: 口說表達「I AM FORTY YEARS OLD」(phr.)：請唸出短句：我今年四十歲。。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：我可以點餐了嗎？
normal.explain: 口說表達「CAN I ORDER NOW」(phr.)：請唸出短句：我可以點餐了嗎？。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：請給我一杯柳橙汁。
normal.explain: 口說表達「AN ORANGE JUICE PLEASE」(phr.)：請唸出短句：請給我一杯柳橙汁。。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：請給我一碗熱湯。
normal.explain: 口說表達「A BOWL OF SOUP PLEASE」(phr.)：請唸出短句：請給我一碗熱湯。。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：這道菜會辣嗎？
normal.explain: 口說表達「IS THIS DISH SPICY」(phr.)：請唸出短句：這道菜會辣嗎？。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：地鐵站在哪裡？
normal.explain: 口說表達「WHERE IS THE SUBWAY STATION」(phr.)：請唸出短句：地鐵站在哪裡？。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：它在你的右邊。
normal.explain: 口說表達「IT IS ON YOUR RIGHT」(phr.)：請唸出短句：它在你的右邊。。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：它離這裡很遠嗎？
normal.explain: 口說表達「IS IT FAR FROM HERE」(phr.)：請唸出短句：它離這裡很遠嗎？。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：我可以試穿這件嗎？
normal.explain: 口說表達「CAN I TRY THIS ON」(phr.)：請唸出短句：我可以試穿這件嗎？。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：你們有藍色的嗎？
normal.ans: DO YOU HAVE A BLUE ONE
normal.speak: do you have a blue one
normal.explain: 口說表達「DO YOU HAVE A BLUE ONE」(phr.)：請唸出短句：你們有藍色的嗎？。

normal.desc: 請唸出短句：我買下這個了。
normal.explain: 口說表達「I WILL TAKE THIS ONE」(phr.)：請唸出短句：我買下這個了。。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】The ___ is on the desk.
normal.explain: 句子的主詞需要一個單數名詞來搭配 is，且前面已經有 The，所以選單數名詞 pen。選項 B 是複數，選項 C 冠詞與複數衝突，選項 D 是所有格。

normal.desc: 【職場文法】She ___ an email to her boss every day.
normal.explain: 主詞 She 是第三人稱單數，現在簡單式動詞字尾需要加 -s，因此選 writes。every day 表示習慣性動作。

normal.desc: 【旅遊介系詞】The taxi is waiting ___ the bank.
normal.explain: 表達「在某個特定地點（銀行）」使用介系詞 at。(A) of 表示「…的」；(B) with 表示「和…一起」；(D) to 表示方向，不能和 is waiting 表示所在位置。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】___ are two birds in the park.
normal.explain: There are 表示「有」，後面接複數名詞 two birds，所以選 There。(A) They 是「他們」；(B) Their 是所有格「他們的」；(D) These 是「這些」，後面要接名詞。

normal.desc: 【職場字彙】My computer is on the ___ in the office.
normal.explain: 句子 My computer is on the ___ 中，最合理的物品是 desk（辦公桌）。park（公園）、taxi（計程車）、milk（牛奶）皆不合語意。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】He can ___ very well.
normal.explain: 助動詞 can 後面必須接原形動詞。He can ___ very well. 應填入 sing。

normal.desc: 【旅遊文法】___ flight is late, so we wait at the airport.
normal.explain: ___ flight is late. 需要一個所有格形容詞來修飾名詞 flight。Our（我們的）符合文法，We 是主詞，Us 是受詞。

normal.desc: 【職場介系詞】The meeting is ___ Monday.
normal.explain: 表達「在星期幾」使用介系詞 on。The meeting is ___ Monday. 故選 on。

normal.desc: 【生活字彙】The ___ is flying in the sky.
normal.explain: The ___ is flying in the sky. 能飛的通常是 bird（鳥）。sofa（沙發）、bank（銀行）、paper（紙）不合邏輯。

normal.desc: 【旅遊文法】A: ___ is the bank? B: It is next to the park.
normal.explain: ___ is the bank? It is next to the park. 答句回答地點，因此疑問詞要用 Where（哪裡）。

normal.desc: 【生活介系詞】He lives ___ Taipei.
normal.explain: He lives ___ Taipei. 居住在較大的城市或國家，介系詞使用 in。

normal.desc: 【職場文法】Mr. Lin ___ work here.
normal.explain: Mr. Lin ___ work here. 主詞是第三人稱單數，一般動詞的否定需用 doesn't。

normal.desc: 【生活字彙】I take a ___ to the bank.
normal.explain: I take a ___ to the bank. take a taxi 表示「搭計程車」，符合語意。

normal.desc: 【旅遊對話】A: Where ___ the bus? B: It is here.
normal.explain: 主詞 the bus 是單數，be 動詞用 is。(A) am 只用在 I；(B) are 用在複數或 you；(D) be 是原形，不能直接當主要動詞。

normal.desc: 【職場對話】A: Is this pen mine? B: Yes, it is ___.
normal.explain: 空格要表示「你的（筆）」，後面沒有名詞，要用所有格代名詞 yours。(B) your 後面一定要接名詞；(C) you 是主格／受格；(D) yourself 是反身代名詞。

normal.desc: 【生活對話】A: What does your friend do at night? B: He usually ___ a movie.
normal.explain: A: What does your friend do at night? B: He usually ___ a movie. 主詞 He 為第三人稱單數，動詞需加 -es，選 watches。

normal.desc: 【旅遊文法】We can ___ a car to the park on Sunday.
normal.explain: We can ___ a car to the park. 助動詞 can 後面必須使用原形動詞 drive。

normal.desc: 【職場文法】She has a pen, ___ she does not have any paper.
normal.explain: She has a pen, ___ she does not have any paper. 前後句意呈現對比（有...但是沒有...），故選 but。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】There is ___ egg on the table.
normal.explain: egg 的發音以母音開頭，不定冠詞用 an。There is 用來介紹新出現的東西，不用 the；any 不和單數可數名詞連用。

normal.desc: 【旅遊對話】A: ___ a bank near here? B: Yes, there is. It is on this street.
normal.explain: A: ___ a bank near here? B: Yes, it is on this street. 答句是單數，且為問句形式，故選 Is there。

normal.desc: 【職場介系詞】A: When is the meeting? B: It is ___ 10:00.
normal.explain: A: When is the meeting? B: It is ___ 10:00. 表示明確的鐘點時刻，介系詞必須用 at。

normal.desc: 【生活對話】A: It is cold. B: Please ___ the door.
normal.explain: A: It is cold. B: Please ___ the door. 祈使句的動詞必須用原形，因此選 close。

normal.desc: 【旅遊字彙】We ride a ___ in the park.
normal.explain: We ride a ___ in the park. 搭配動詞 ride（騎），合理的受詞是 bicycle（腳踏車）。

normal.desc: 【職場文法】The clerk ___ busy on Mondays.
normal.explain: The clerk ___ busy on Mondays. 頻率副詞 always 的位置在 be 動詞之後，因此選 is always。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】___ pens are red, and those pens are blue.
normal.explain: ___ pens are red, and those pens are blue. 因為名詞 pens 是複數，前面的指示代名詞需用複數 These。

normal.desc: 【旅遊對話】A: ___ do you go to the bank? B: By taxi.
normal.explain: A: ___ do you go to the bank? B: By taxi. 答句回答交通方式（搭計程車），因此問句要用 How（如何）。

normal.desc: 【職場對話】A: Where is Mr. Lin? B: I do not see ___.
normal.explain: A: Where is Mr. Lin? B: I do not see ___. see 是動詞，後面需要接受格 him。

normal.desc: 【生活介系詞】The cat is sleeping ___ the sofa.
normal.explain: The cat is sleeping ___ the sofa. 表達空間位置關係「在...下方」，選 under 最符合文法與語意。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Note] Please put the paper on the desk. Do not put it on the sofa.
Q: Where does the paper go?
normal.explain: 便條紙上明確寫著「Please put the paper on the desk.（請把紙放在辦公桌上）」，因此答案是 B。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Sign] The park is open from 8:00 to 18:00. No bicycles inside.
Q: What is NOT allowed in the park?
normal.explain: 告示牌寫著「No bicycles inside.（裡面禁止腳踏車）」，所以不被允許的是 bicycles。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Email] Hi Tom, I am at the bank now. I will go to the office at 14:00. See you there.
Q: Where is the writer now?
normal.explain: 信件中寫道「I am at the bank now.（我現在在銀行）」，故答案選 A。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Message] Mary, we need milk and meat for dinner. Please buy them at the store.
Q: What does Mary need to buy?
normal.explain: 訊息提到「we need milk and meat for dinner.（我們晚餐需要牛奶和肉）」，因此她需要買的是牛奶和肉。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Work Schedule] Monday: Meeting. Tuesday: Write emails. Wednesday: Visit the bank.
Q: What does the person do on Tuesday?
normal.explain: 行程表上列出「Tuesday: Write emails.（星期二：寫電子郵件）」，故選 C。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Notice] The singer will sing in the park today at 19:00. The ticket is 100 NT dollars.
Q: How much is the ticket?
normal.explain: 公告中註明「The ticket is 100 NT dollars.（門票 100 台幣）」，所以選 C。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Memo] Boss, your taxi is here. It is black. The driver is waiting outside.
Q: What color is the taxi?
normal.explain: 便條中提到計程車「It is black.（它是黑色的）」，因此選 D。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Store Sign] Open Monday to Friday. Closed on Saturday and Sunday.
Q: Is the store open on Sunday?
options: C. It is open at night.
D. It is open for drivers only.
normal.explain: 告示寫「Closed on Saturday and Sunday.（週六與週日休息）」，因此週日沒有營業，選 B。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Email] Dear Team, we have a new sofa in the break room. You can sit there and read books.
Q: What is new in the break room?
normal.explain: 信件提到「we have a new sofa in the break room.（我們的休息室有新沙發）」，所以新物品是沙發。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Message] Hey Jim, I cannot find my blue pen. Is it on your desk?
Q: What is the writer looking for?
normal.explain: 訊息中寫「I cannot find my blue pen.（我找不到我的藍筆）」，所以他在尋找藍筆。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】I ___ hungry. Can we eat lunch now?
normal.explain: 主詞是 I，be 動詞要用 am。(A) is 用於 he/she/it 等單數第三人稱；(C) are 用於 you、we、they；(D) be 是原形，不能直接當主要動詞。

normal.desc: 【學校文法】My classmates ___ very friendly.
normal.explain: 主詞 My classmates 是複數，be 動詞用 are。(A) is 用於單數；(B) am 只用於 I；(D) be 是原形。

normal.desc: 【家庭文法】My grandmother ___ seventy years old.
normal.explain: 主詞 My grandmother 是單數第三人稱，be 動詞用 is。(A) are 用於複數；(B) am 只用於 I；(C) be 是原形。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】This is my brother. ___ is a student.
normal.explain: my brother（我的哥哥／弟弟）是男生、單數，代名詞用 He。(B) She 指女生；(C) They、(D) We 是複數。

normal.desc: 【家庭文法】My mother is a nurse. ___ works at a hospital.
normal.explain: my mother 是女生、單數，代名詞用 She。(A) He 指男生；(C) It 指東西或動物；(D) They 是複數。

normal.desc: 【學校文法】Tom and I are in the same class. ___ are good friends.
normal.explain: Tom and I（湯姆和我）包含「我」，代名詞用 We。(A) They 不包含說話的人；(B) He 是單數；(D) You 指聽話的人。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】Look at the cat! ___ is very cute.
normal.explain: 動物（不知道性別時）用 It 代替。(B) He、(D) She 通常指人；(C) They 是複數。

normal.desc: 【職場文法】Anna and Ben work here. ___ are very busy today.
normal.explain: Anna and Ben 是兩個人、不包含說話的人，代名詞用 They。(A) We 包含「我」；(B) She、(C) He 是單數。

normal.desc: 【生活對話】A: Are you a teacher? B: Yes, ___ am.
normal.explain: 對方問 Are you…?，回答自己的事要用 I，所以是 Yes, I am。(A) you 是對方；(C) he、(D) we 和 am 不搭配。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】I have ___ apple in my bag.
normal.explain: apple 開頭是母音的發音，單數可數名詞前用 an。(A) a 用於子音開頭；(C) two、(D) many 後面要接複數 apples。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】My father drives ___ car to work.
normal.explain: car 開頭是子音的發音，單數名詞前用 a。(A) an 用於母音開頭（如 an egg）；(C)(D) 後面要接複數。

normal.desc: 【職場文法】She is ___ engineer.
normal.explain: engineer 開頭是母音的發音，前面用 an。(A) a 用於子音開頭；(C)(D) 和單數 engineer 不搭配。

normal.desc: 【旅遊文法】We stay in ___ hotel near the beach.
normal.explain: hotel 開頭的 h 有發音（子音），單數名詞前用 a。(A) an 用於母音發音開頭；(C) some、(D) two 後面要接複數 hotels。

normal.desc: 【學校文法】Please wait ___ hour. The teacher is in a meeting.
normal.explain: hour 的 h 不發音，開頭是母音的發音，所以用 an hour。(A) a 用於子音發音開頭；(C) two、(D) many 後面要接複數 hours。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】I ___ to school by bus every day.
normal.explain: 主詞 I 用動詞原形，一般現在式說 I go。(B) goes 用於 he/she/it；(C) going 前面缺 be 動詞；(D) am go 文法錯誤。

normal.desc: 【家庭文法】We ___ breakfast at seven every morning.
normal.explain: 主詞 We 是複數，一般現在式用原形 eat。(A) eats 用於單數第三人稱；(C) eating 前面缺 be 動詞；(D) is eat 文法錯誤。

normal.desc: 【職場文法】They ___ English at work every day.
normal.explain: 主詞 They 是複數，一般現在式用原形 speak。(A) speaks 用於單數第三人稱；(B) speaking 前面缺 be 動詞；(D) is speak 文法錯誤。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】I ___ like coffee. I like tea.
normal.explain: 主詞 I 的一般現在式否定用 don't + 原形動詞。(B) doesn't 用於 he/she/it；(C) isn't、(D) am not 是 be 動詞的否定，後面不能直接接動詞 like。

normal.desc: 【家庭文法】My sister ___ eat meat. She only eats vegetables.
normal.explain: 主詞 My sister 是單數第三人稱，否定用 doesn't + 原形動詞。(A) don't 用於 I/you/we/they；(B) isn't、(D) aren't 是 be 動詞的否定。

normal.desc: 【學校文法】We ___ have class on Sunday.
normal.explain: 主詞 We 用 don't + 原形動詞。(A) doesn't 用於單數第三人稱；(C) aren't、(D) isn't 是 be 動詞的否定，不能接 have。

normal.desc: 【家庭文法】My uncle ___ a new car, and he drives it to work.
normal.explain: 本題測試現在簡單式。主詞 My uncle 為第三人稱單數，動詞需用 has。選項 A 缺乏 be 動詞不能當本動詞，選項 B 用於複數，選項 D 文法錯誤，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】His wife ___ English at a language school in Taipei.
normal.explain: 本題測試第三人稱單數動詞的變化。主詞 His wife 為單數，動詞 study 字尾為子音加 y，需去 y 加 ies，故選 A。

normal.desc: 【家庭介系詞】My grandfather usually reads the newspaper ___ the evening.
normal.explain: 本題測試時間介系詞。在早上、下午或傍晚的固定片語需使用 in（如 in the morning, in the evening），故選 D。

normal.desc: 【生活文法】We ___ up at six o'clock every day.
normal.explain: 本題測試現在簡單式。主詞 We 為第一人稱複數，描述每天發生的習慣時，動詞需用原形，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【生活字彙】Can you help me clean the ___? It is very dirty.
normal.explain: 本題測試生活字彙。句意為「你能幫我打掃房子嗎？它非常髒。」，只有 house 符合語境，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【家庭對話】A: ___ is that tall man over there? B: He is my uncle, David.
normal.explain: 本題測試疑問詞。回答提到「他是我叔叔」，表示詢問的是「人」，必須使用 Who（誰），故選 B。

normal.desc: 【生活對話】A: ___ do you usually clean your house? B: I clean it every Saturday.
normal.explain: 本題測試疑問詞。回答提到「每週六」，表示詢問的是「時間」，必須使用 When（何時），故選 D。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Note on Fridge] Hi Leo, I am going to the market to buy some fish and tomatoes. Please help me wash the rice before I come back. Mom.
Q: What does Mom want Leo to do?
normal.explain: 本題測試短文理解。媽媽在便條紙中寫道「Please help me wash the rice before I come back.」（請在我回來前幫忙洗米），故選 B。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[Diary] October 12. It is my aunt's birthday. We are having a large meal in the garden. My cousin makes a beautiful chocolate cake. It is very sweet.
Q: Where is the birthday meal?
normal.explain: 本題測試短文理解。日記中提到「We are having a large meal in the garden.」（我們正在花園裡吃大餐），故選 C。

normal.desc: 【食物文法】___ there any cheese on the table?
normal.explain: 本題測試 There is/are 句型。起司（cheese）為不可數名詞，需視為單數，搭配 be 動詞 Is，故選 A。

normal.desc: 【購物文法】I want to buy three red ___ from the market.
normal.explain: 本題測試名詞複數。數字 three 後面需接複數名詞，tomato 字尾為 o，複數形式需加上 es，故選 D。

normal.desc: 【食物文法】The fish in the bowl ___ very fresh.
normal.explain: 本題測試 be 動詞與主詞一致性。這裡指碗裡的「魚肉」或單一一條魚，作為單一主體時搭配單數 be 動詞 is，故選 A。

normal.desc: 【購物介系詞】Look at the shoes ___ the box. They are beautiful.
normal.explain: 本題測試空間介系詞。表示物品在某個容器「裡面」，需使用 in，故選 A。

normal.desc: 【食物字彙】Tom eats a lot of ___ for his lunch.
normal.explain: 本題測試不可數名詞。米飯（rice）是不可數名詞，不能加 s 也不加不定冠詞 a，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【購物對話】A: ___ much is this black wallet? B: It is three hundred dollars.
normal.explain: 本題測試疑問詞。詢問價格時固定使用片語 How much，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【食物對話】A: What do you want to eat? B: I would like a piece of ___.
normal.explain: 本題測試量詞搭配。a piece of 後面接單數不可數狀態的名詞，表示「一塊蛋糕」，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【學校文法】There ___ five pencils in my pencil case.
normal.explain: 本題測試 There is/are 句型。five pencils 為複數，be 動詞必須使用 are，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【學校介系詞】Please put your homework ___ the teacher's desk.
normal.explain: 本題測試空間介系詞。表示將物品放在平面的物體「上面」（如桌面上），需使用 on，故選 A。

normal.desc: 【學校文法】___ your friend play basketball after school?
normal.explain: 本題測試一般動詞的疑問句。主詞 your friend 為第三人稱單數，助動詞需使用 Does，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【學校文法】That is not ___ ruler. Mine is blue.
normal.explain: 本題測試所有格形容詞。ruler 為名詞，前面需要加所有格 your（你的），選項 C 是所有格代名詞，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【學校文法】I ___ write with a pen because I make a lot of mistakes.
normal.explain: 本題測試助動詞。write 為原形動詞，前面需搭配助動詞，cannot 表示「無法/不能」，符合語境「我不能用原子筆寫，因為我常犯錯」，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【學校對話】A: ___ is my red pen? B: It is under your desk.
normal.explain: 本題測試疑問詞。回答提到位置「在你的書桌下」，表示詢問的是「地點」，必須使用 Where，故選 D。

normal.desc: 【學校對話】A: ___ you read the words on the whiteboard? B: No, I cannot. They are too small.
normal.explain: 本題測試助動詞。根據回答的「No, I cannot.」，可推知問句是用助動詞 Can 開頭，詢問能力，故選 B。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[School Rules] 1. Do not eat or drink during the lesson. 2. Please turn off your phone. 3. Raise your hand if you want to speak.
Q: What can a student do?
options: B. Raise a hand to speak
normal.explain: 本題測試短文理解。規則中明確禁止上課飲食與使用手機，唯一允許且被要求的是「Raise your hand if you want to speak.」（發言前請舉手），故選 B。

normal.desc: 【季節介系詞】We like to play sports ___ summer.
normal.explain: 本題測試時間介系詞。在某個季節（春夏秋冬）前面，介系詞必須使用 in，故選 D。

normal.desc: 【天氣字彙】Look at the dark clouds in the ___.
normal.explain: 本題測試天氣字彙。烏雲會出現在「天空」中，sky 意為天空，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【天氣文法】It ___ very windy right now, so please wear a coat.
normal.explain: 本題測試 be 動詞。主詞為代名詞 It（指天氣），be 動詞需搭配 is，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【季節文法】The trees ___ beautiful in autumn.
normal.explain: 本題測試 be 動詞。主詞 The trees 為複數，描述狀態需搭配 be 動詞 are，故選 A。

normal.desc: 【天氣文法】___ it get cold in Taiwan during winter?
normal.explain: 本題測試一般動詞的疑問句。主詞為 it，動詞 get 是原形動詞，疑問句需使用助動詞 Does 開頭，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【天氣對話】A: Is it warm outside right now? B: No, it is very ___. You need a jacket.
normal.explain: 本題測試天氣形容詞。對方問是否溫暖，回答「No」表示不溫暖，且建議穿夾克，代表天氣偏涼（cool），故選 D。

normal.desc:
【短文理解】[News Report] Tomorrow will be windy and cool in Taipei. In the evening, the temperature will drop to 15 degrees. Please remember to wear warm clothes if you go out.
Q: What is Taipei like tomorrow?
normal.explain: 本題測試短文理解。報導第一句話就提到「Tomorrow will be windy and cool in Taipei.」（明天台北將會起風且涼爽），故選 A。

normal.desc: 【動物文法】The elephant ___ a very long trunk.
normal.explain: 本題測試一般動詞。主詞 The elephant 為第三人稱單數，表示「擁有」時動詞必須用 has，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【顏色字彙】My favorite color is ___. It is the color of the sky.
normal.explain: 本題測試顏色字彙。後句提示「這是天空的顏色」，天空的顏色為藍色（blue），故選 C。

normal.desc: 【動物文法】Look at the cute pig! ___ tail is short and curly.
normal.explain: 本題測試所有格。修飾名詞 tail（尾巴）需要所有格代名詞，動物的「牠的」寫法為 Its，沒有撇號，故選 D。

normal.desc: 【顏色文法】She wears a pink dress and two white ___.
normal.explain: 本題測試名詞複數。two 表示數量為二，後面的名詞 shoe（鞋子）需加上 s 變複數形式，故選 A。

normal.desc: 【動物介系詞】The cows are sleeping ___ the tall tree.
normal.explain: 本題測試空間介系詞。牛群睡在高大的樹下，表示在物體正下方的遮蔽處，需使用 under，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【我的房間】There ___ a small bed in my house.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試 There is/are 句型。主詞 a small bed（一張小床）是單數名詞，因此 be 動詞必須使用 is。選項 B 用於複數；C 用於主詞 I；D 為原形動詞，不能直接放在這裡。

normal.desc: 【我的房間】The lamp is ___ the desk.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試地方介系詞。檯燈通常是放在書桌的「表面上」，因此使用 on（在...上面）。選項 A in 是在...裡面，不符合邏輯；C of 和 D to 不是表達位置的介系詞。

normal.desc: 【家】I ___ in a small apartment.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試現在簡單式。主詞為第一人稱 I 時，後面的動詞要用原形 live。選項 A lives 用於第三人稱單數（如 He/She/It）；B living 為現在分詞；D to live 為不定詞。

normal.desc: 【家】A: Where is your new book? B: It is ___ the bed.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試地方介系詞。回答物品的位置時，under 表示「在...下方」，符合句意（它在床底下）。選項 A、B、C 無法正確表達書和床的相對位置關係。

normal.desc: 【我的房間】A: ___ this your pen? B: No, it is her pen.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試 be 動詞疑問句。主詞 this（這個）是單數，且句中沒有一般動詞，所以必須使用 be 動詞 Is 開頭。選項 B Are 用於複數；C 和 D 用於有一般動詞的句子中。

normal.desc: 【我的房間】I have a clock. It ___ on the wall.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試主動詞一致性。第二句的主詞 It 代表前面提到的時鐘（單數），因此搭配的 be 動詞是 is。選項 A are 用於複數或 You；C am 專用於 I；D do 是助動詞不合語法。

normal.desc: 【我的房間】My books are ___ the box.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試地方介系詞。書本通常是裝在箱子的「裡面」，因此正確的介系詞是 in（在...之中）。選項 A on 是在表面上；B at 指特定地點；D to 表示方向。

normal.desc: 【朋友】Peter ___ a very good friend.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試 be 動詞。主詞 Peter 是第三人稱單數，現在式 be 動詞必須用 is。選項 A be 是原形；B are 用於複數或第二人稱；D am 用於第一人稱 I。

normal.desc: 【寵物】She ___ a black cat.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試現在簡單式動詞變化。主詞 She 為第三人稱單數，表示擁有的動詞 have 必須改為單數形式 has。選項 A have 用於 I/You/We/They；B 和 C 形式錯誤，不能作主要動詞。

normal.desc: 【寵物】The dog ___ fast.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試現在簡單式第三人稱單數。主詞 The dog 是一隻狗（單數），一般動詞字尾必須加 s，故選 runs。選項 B run 少了 s；C 和 D 不是完整的謂語動詞形式。

normal.desc: 【寵物】A: What is that? B: It is ___ white bird.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試冠詞用法。bird 是單數可數名詞，前面有形容詞 white，發音以子音開頭，因此不定冠詞要用 a。選項 A an 用於母音開頭；C two 和 D some 皆用於複數名詞。

normal.desc: 【朋友】Mary and Lisa ___ in the park.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試 be 動詞。主詞 Mary and Lisa 是兩個人（複數），所以 be 動詞必須用 are。選項 A 用於 I；B 用於單數主詞；D be 為原形，不符合現在式文法。

normal.desc: 【寵物】Does your friend ___ a pet?
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試助動詞與動詞原形。疑問句已經使用了助動詞 Does，後面的主要動詞必須恢復為原形 have。選項 A has 是第三人稱單數形態，在此不能重複使用；B 和 C 形式皆錯。

normal.desc: 【朋友】A: ___ do you play with? B: I play with my friend, Ken.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試疑問詞。回答是「我的朋友 Ken」，表示在問「人」，因此疑問詞要用 Who（誰）。選項 B 問事物；C 問地點；D 問時間，皆不符合回答內容。

normal.desc: 【早餐】I eat bread ___ seven.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試時間介系詞。表示在具體的幾點鐘（seven 代表七點），前面必須搭配介系詞 at。選項 B in 通常用於月份或年份；C on 用於特定日期或星期；D to 表示方向。

normal.desc: 【午餐】He ___ salad for lunch.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試現在簡單式的動詞變化。主詞 He 是第三人稱單數，一般動詞 eat 必須在字尾加上 s 成為 eats。選項 A 缺少 s；C 和 D 不是可獨立存在的主要動詞形態。

normal.desc: 【早餐】Do you want some ___ in your tea?
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試不可數名詞的用法。milk（牛奶）是不可數名詞，不能加上 a，字尾也不能加 s。因此只能選原形的 milk。選項 A、B、D 的用法都是錯誤的。

normal.desc: 【午餐】The meat ___ very good.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試不可數名詞的 be 動詞。meat（肉）是不可數名詞，在文法上視為單數，因此 be 動詞要用 is。選項 A are 用於複數；B am 專屬於 I；C be 是原形。

normal.desc: 【午餐】A: ___ they like fish? B: Yes, they do.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試現在簡單式的疑問句。主詞是 they（他們），且句中有一般動詞 like，所以問句必須用助動詞 Do 開頭。選項 B Does 用於單數；C 和 D 是 be 動詞，不能與一般動詞連用。

normal.desc: 【午餐】A: ___ is your lunch? B: It is on the table.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試疑問詞。回答是「on the table（在桌上）」，表示在問物品的位置（地點），因此疑問詞要用 Where（哪裡）。選項 A 問事物；C 問人；D 問時間。

normal.desc: 【早餐】I do not ___ tea. I like hot milk.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試助動詞與原形動詞。在否定助動詞 do not (don't) 之後，動詞必須恢復為原形 drink。選項 A drinks 有 s 是錯的；B drinking 和 D to drink 形態皆不符文法。

normal.desc: 【城市】There are many shops ___ this town.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試地方介系詞。表示在一個城鎮或城市「裡面」時，介系詞通常使用 in（在...之中）。選項 A at 通常指特定的小地點；B to 表方向；D with 表伴隨。

normal.desc: 【公園】The tree ___ very tall.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試 be 動詞。主詞 The tree 是一棵樹（單數），因此對應的 be 動詞是 is。選項 A am 用於 I；B are 用於複數；C be 為動詞原形。

normal.desc: 【城市】Can you ___ the bank?
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試助動詞的用法。Can 是助動詞，後面的主要動詞必須是原形。因此選 see。選項 B sees 有加 s；C 是現在分詞；D 是不定詞，均不符合文法規則。

normal.desc: 【公園】We run ___ the park.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試地方介系詞。表示在公園這片區域內活動，介系詞用 in（在...裡面）。選項 A on 是在表面上；C to 是往某個方向去；D from 是從某處來。

normal.desc: 【城市】A: How do you go to the bank? B: I ___ by taxi.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試現在簡單式。主詞是第一人稱 I，動詞必須使用原形 go。選項 A goes 用於第三人稱單數（如 He/She）；B going 為現在分詞；D to go 為不定詞，皆不合語法。

normal.desc: 【公園】Look! The birds ___ in the tree.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試 be 動詞。主詞 The birds（鳥）是複數名詞，所以搭配的 be 動詞必須是 are。選項 A is 用於單數；B am 用於 I；C to be 是不定詞。

normal.desc: 【城市】A: ___ is the store open? B: At nine.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試疑問詞。B 的回答是「At nine（在九點）」，這是一個時間，因此疑問句必須用 When（何時）來提問。選項 B 問人；C 問地點；D 問事物。

normal.desc: 【短文理解】[Sign] Welcome to Central Park. You can sit on the grass. You can read books. You cannot drive a car here. Q: What can you NOT do in this park?
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試短文理解。告示牌提到「You cannot drive a car here.（你不能在這裡開車）」，因此這是在公園裡被禁止的事情。選項 A 和 C 都是可以做的。

normal.desc: 【週末活動】I ___ books on the weekend.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試現在簡單式。主詞 I 代表第一人稱，後接的一般動詞需用原形 read。選項 B reads 適用於第三人稱單數（He/She/It）；C 為現在分詞；D 為不定詞。

normal.desc: 【週末活動】She ___ to the movies on the weekend.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試第三人稱單數動詞。主詞 She 是第三人稱單數，一般動詞 go 必須加上 es 成為 goes。選項 A go 少了 es；C 和 D 都不是正確的主要動詞形式。

normal.desc: 【週末活動】___ you play baseball?
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試助動詞。句中有一般動詞 play，且是在詢問「能力」，所以開頭要用助動詞 Can（你會...嗎？）。選項 A、B、D 都是 be 動詞，不能與原形動詞連用。

normal.desc: 【週末活動】They ___ at the sports club.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試 be 動詞。主詞 They（他們）是複數代名詞，對應的 be 動詞必須是 are。選項 A 用於 I；B 用於第三人稱單數；C 為原形。

normal.desc: 【週末活動】A: What does he do on the weekend? B: He ___ games.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試現在簡單式。回答句的主詞 He 是第三人稱單數，動詞 play 必須加上 s 變成 plays。選項 B 少了 s；C 和 D 不能作句子的主要動詞。

normal.desc: 【週末活動】I want to ___ a movie.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試不定詞用法。want to 後面必須接「原形動詞」，表示想要做某事，因此選擇 watch。選項 A 有加 es；C 為現在分詞；D 格式錯誤。

normal.desc: 【週末活動】A: ___ do you read books? B: At home.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試疑問詞。回答是「At home（在家）」，指的是地點，所以問句的疑問詞必須用 Where（在哪裡）。選項 A 問人；B 問事物；D 問時間。

normal.desc: 【短文理解】[Note] John, let's play sports on the weekend. We need a ball. We will meet at the park at ten. Q: What do they need?
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試短文細節理解。便條紙中寫到「We need a ball.（我們需要一顆球）」，所以他們需要的是球。其他選項皆未在文中提及。

normal.desc: 🎧 【餐廳點水】請聽服務生詢問並選出正確回應：
normal.speak: Still or sparkling water for the table?
normal.explain: 服務生詢問要「常溫水還是氣泡水？」（Still or sparkling water），最適當的回答是「請給我們常溫水」（Still water, please）。

boss.desc: 【旅遊文法】A: Excuse me, ___ any good coffee shops near this bus stop? B: Yes, there is a very famous one across the street.
boss.explain: 問句修飾複數名詞 good coffee shops，疑問句形式須將 be 動詞倒裝，故使用 Are there。(A) is there 用於單數名詞；(C) 英語無 have there 句型；(D) there are 為肯定句語序，非問句。

boss.desc: 【生活字彙】Emily is an assistant. She ___ calls from customers and writes emails every afternoon.
boss.explain: 接聽電話在英語中習慣搭配「answer calls/phones」，主詞為單數第三人稱故用 answers。(B) makes calls 是撥打電話，與文意中助理處理客戶進線不合；(C) listens 後須加 to 且不用於接聽電話；(D) speaks 後面不直接加 calls。

boss.desc: 【職場介系詞】Our company is on the fifth floor, and the staff cafeteria is ___ the basement.
boss.explain: 地下室空間通常使用介系詞 in the basement。(A) on 一般用於樓層如 on the first/second floor，但地下室習慣用 in；(B) at 常用於特定地址或點；(C) to 表示方向。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Notice on Office Fridge] All food in this refrigerator must have a name tag with today's date. The cleaning staff cleans the fridge every Friday at 5:00 p.m. Any food without a name will be thrown away.
Q: What will happen to an apple without a name on Friday evening?
options: A. The staff will throw it away.
B. It will stay in the fridge.
D. It will go to the office desk.
boss.explain: 文中最後一句「Any food without a name will be thrown away.」說明沒有標示名字的食物會在週五清掃時被丟掉。(B)、(C)、(D) 皆與規定不符。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Flight Ticket Message] Flight BR28 to San Francisco is delayed. The new departure time is 11:45 p.m. Passengers can wait at Gate 12 and get a free drink voucher from the service desk.
Q: What should passengers do if they want a free drink?
options: B. Go to the service desk.
boss.explain: 文末指出旅客可以「get a free drink voucher from the service desk」（在服務台領取免費飲料兌換券），故選 B。(A) 班機延誤尚未登機；(C) 兌換券是免費的無須付費；(D) 文中並未要求更換機票。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Apartment Rules] Welcome to your new home. Please do not play loud music after 10:00 p.m. Put your trash bags in the collection area on the first floor before 8:00 a.m. every morning except Sunday.
Q: Which of the following is true according to the rules?
options: A. You can play loud music at midnight.
B. There is no trash collection on Sunday.
C. The trash area is on the roof.
D. You must move out before 8:00 a.m.
boss.explain: 文中「every morning except Sunday」表示星期日沒有垃圾清運，故選 B。(A) 晚上十點後不可大聲放音樂；(C) 垃圾放置區在一樓而非屋頂；(D) 8:00 a.m. 是丟垃圾的截止時間，不是搬家時間。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Business Email] Dear Team, John is sick today and cannot lead the marketing meeting at 3 p.m. Mary will take his place today. Please send your weekly reports to Mary before 2 p.m.
Q: Who will lead the marketing meeting today?
boss.explain: 文中明確提到「Mary will take his place today」（瑪麗今天將代替他主持），因此今天由 Mary 主持會議。(A)、(C) 文中未提及；(B) John 今天生病請假無法主持。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Train Station Broadcast] Attention all passengers: The 9:15 train to Hualien is full. If you do not have a reserved seat, please buy a ticket for the next train at 10:00 at ticket window 3.
Q: What can a person without a ticket do to go to Hualien?
options: B. Take the 9:15 train without a seat.
boss.explain: 廣播說明 9:15 的火車已客滿，沒有劃位的旅客應購買 10:00 的下一班車，故選 A。(B) 9:15 已客滿無法無票上車；(C)、(D) 皆不合理且未提及。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Job Advertisement] Star Coffee Shop is looking for a weekend waiter. Working hours are from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Saturdays and Sundays. Good English communication skills are welcome. Please call Mr. Wu at 0912-345-678.
Q: Who can apply for this job?
options: A. A person who can only work on Mondays.
B. A person who wants to work on weekends.
C. A person looking for a night shift.
D. A person who wants to cook in a hotel.
boss.explain: 該職缺為「weekend waiter」，工作時間為「Saturdays and Sundays」，因此適合能在週末工作的人。(A) 只能在週一工作不合；(C) 工作時間為白天 10:00 至 18:00，非大夜班；(D) 應徵的是咖啡店服務生而非飯店廚師。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Office Kitchen Notice] Please label your lunchbox with your name and department. Any box without a name will be removed every Friday at 4:30 p.m. Please do not leave dirty forks or bowls in the sink overnight.
Q: What will the cleaner do to an unlabeled lunchbox on Friday at 5:00 p.m.?
options: A. Wash it and put it away.
B. Move it to the 4th floor.
C. Throw it away or remove it.
D. Send an email to the owner.
boss.explain: 文中說明「Any box without a name will be removed every Friday at 4:30 p.m.」（沒有標註名字的餐盒會在週五下午四點半被清除丟棄），故選 C。(A)、(B)、(D) 皆非清潔人員的處置方式。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Express Train Schedule] Train 105: Leaves Taipei at 07:15, arrives in Taichung at 08:20, arrives in Zuoying at 09:10. Train 107: Leaves Taipei at 07:45, does NOT stop in Taichung, arrives in Zuoying at 09:20.
Q: If Mr. Lin takes Train 107 in Taipei, can he get off at Taichung?
options: C. No, because Train 107 is canceled.
D. No, because Train 107 does not stop there.
boss.explain: 時刻表明確說明 Train 107「does NOT stop in Taichung」（不停靠台中），因此林先生無法在台中下車，故選 D。(A) 是 105 車次的台中抵達時間；(B) 是左營抵達時間；(C) 班車未取消。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Text Message Chain] John: 'Hey Lisa, the manager wants us to finish the presentation slides before our 3:00 meeting.' Lisa: 'I already finished the charts. Can you write the summary page?' John: 'Sure, I can do that now.'
Q: What will John do next?
boss.explain: Lisa 詢問 John 能否寫總結頁面（Can you write the summary page?），John 回答「Sure, I can do that now.」，表示他接下來會去寫總結頁面，故選 A。(B) Lisa 已經做完了圖表；(C)、(D) 與簡訊對話內容無關。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Restaurant Policy Note] Table reservations are held for 10 minutes only. If all guests are not present within 10 minutes after the reserved time, your table will be given to waiting walk-in customers.
Q: What happens if a group of four arrives 15 minutes late for their reservation?
options: B. Their table may be given away.
C. They must pay double price.
D. The restaurant will be closed.
boss.explain: 規定說明座位僅保留 10 分鐘，若逾時「table will be given to waiting walk-in customers」（桌位將轉讓給現場候位客人），遲到 15 分鐘桌位可能不保，故選 B。(A)、(C)、(D) 均不符合內文事實。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Hualien] Dear Eric, Taroko Gorge is breathtaking! Yesterday we walked along the Shakadang Trail. My sister was tired, but she finished the entire walk. Tomorrow we will ride bicycles along the coast before heading home. See you Tuesday! Ken.
Q: What is Ken's plan for tomorrow?
options: A. Walk the mountain trail again.
B. Rest at the hotel all day.
C. Ride bicycles along the coast.
D. Visit a museum in Taipei.
boss.explain: 文中「Tomorrow we will ride bicycles along the coast before heading home.」直接點出明天的行程是沿海岸騎腳踏車，故選 C。(A) 是昨天的行程；(B)、(D) 與內文明確計畫矛盾。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Dentist Clinic Notice] Clinic Hours: Monday to Friday 9:00 a.m. to 8:30 p.m. Saturday: 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon. Sunday: Closed. For urgent tooth pain outside opening hours, please call emergency line 0988-111-222.
Q: When is the clinic open on Saturday afternoon?
options: D. It is not open in the afternoon.
boss.explain: 告示說明週六營業時間僅到中午十二點（Saturday: 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon），因此週六下午並未開診，選 D。(A)、(B)、(C) 皆違反告示中的看診時段。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Airport Announcement] Attention passengers on flight JL802 to Tokyo: The boarding gate has changed from Gate A7 to Gate C3. Boarding will start at 14:15. Please go directly to Terminal 2, Gate C3 now.
Q: What should passengers on flight JL802 do right now?
options: D. Go to the luggage area.
boss.explain: 廣播指出登機門已更換為 C3，並指示「Please go directly to Terminal 2, Gate C3 now.」，故選 A。(B) 原登機門已更改；(C)、(D) 未提及且非廣播要求之動作。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Email Invitation] Dear Colleagues, We invite you to the company annual dinner on Friday, December 18 at Grand Palace Hotel. Dinner starts at 6:30 p.m. Please reply to this email before next Wednesday to choose beef, fish, or vegetarian.
Q: What must employees do by next Wednesday?
options: A. Pay for the dinner ticket.
B. Choose their meal choice by email.
C. Arrive at Grand Palace Hotel.
boss.explain: 信中指出「Please reply to this email before next Wednesday to choose beef, fish, or vegetarian.」（請在下週三前以回信選擇餐點種類：牛、魚或素食），故選 B。(A) 晚宴由公司舉辦未提及收費；(C) 聚餐日期在 12 月 18 日；(D) 未提及演講。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Notice on Boarding School / Hostel Washroom] The hot water system operates daily from 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., and from 6:00 p.m. to 11:30 p.m. During other hours, only cold water is available in all bathrooms.
Q: Can a resident take a hot shower at 2:00 p.m.?
options: B. Yes, if they pay extra fee.
C. No, hot water is not available at 2:00 p.m.
D. No, because all bathrooms are locked.
boss.explain: 熱水供應時段為 06:00-10:00 與 18:00-23:30，其餘時段僅有冷水（only cold water is available），因此下午 2 點沒有熱水，選 C。(A)、(B) 不符合規定；(D) 浴室未上鎖，只是沒有熱水。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Kelly! I bought two tickets for the pop concert this Saturday night at 7:00 p.m. My brother cannot come with me because of his work. Would you like to come with me? The ticket is free for you!
Q: Why does the writer invite Kelly to the concert?
options: A. Kelly wants to sell concert tickets.
B. The writer's brother cannot go.
C. Kelly is the singer of the concert.
D. The concert is on Sunday afternoon.
boss.explain: 文中說明「My brother cannot come with me because of his work. Would you like to come with me?」（哥哥因為工作無法去，因此詢問 Kelly 是否願意同行），選 B。(A) 不是要賣票而是免費贈送同行；(C) Kelly 是朋友不是歌手；(D) 演唱會是週六晚上。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：冰箱
boss.explain: 口說表達「REFRIGERATOR」(n.)：冰箱。例句：Put the milk in the refrigerator.（把牛奶放進冰箱裡。）

boss.explain: 口說表達「SMARTPHONE」(n.)：智慧型手機。例句：She checks emails on her smartphone.（她用智慧型手機查閱電子郵件。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：預約；掛號
boss.explain: 口說表達「APPOINTMENT」(n.)：預約；掛號。例句：I have a dentist appointment at three.（我三點有牙醫預約。）

boss.explain: 口說表達「CELEBRATION」(n.)：慶祝；慶祝活動。例句：We joined the New Year celebration.（我們參加了跨年慶祝活動。）
