boss.desc: 請唸出短句：我想要和醫生預約掛號。
boss.explain: 口說表達「I NEED A DOCTOR APPOINTMENT」(phr.)：請唸出短句：我想要和醫生預約掛號。。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Text Message Chain] Jason: 'Hey Paul, are you ready for the tennis game at 9:00 a.m.?' Paul: 'The court is wet because of morning rain. The coach said the match will start at 10:30 instead.'
Q: Why is the tennis match delayed?
options: A. Paul lost his tennis racket.
B. The coach is late for work.
C. The court is wet from rain.
D. The sports center is closed.
boss.explain: Paul 說明「The court is wet because of morning rain.」（場地因晨雨潮濕），故延後開打，選 C。(A)、(B)、(D) 均不符合簡訊原因。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Miaoli] Dear Grandpa, we visited an orange orchard in Miaoli today. The owner taught us how to pick ripe sweet oranges. Tomorrow we are visiting an old pottery museum. Love, Brian.
Q: What did Brian do in Miaoli today?
options: A. He bought clothes at a shop.
B. He saw a doctor at a clinic.
C. He went to a cinema.
D. He picked oranges at an orchard.
boss.explain: 明信片說明今天參觀果園「taught us how to pick ripe sweet oranges」（學習採摘成熟香甜的橘子），故選 D。(A)、(B)、(C) 文中未提及。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Clothing Store Sign] Fitting Room Rules: Maximum of four clothing items allowed inside at one time. Please return unbought clothes to the clothing rack outside the fitting room.
Q: What is the maximum number of items a customer can bring into the fitting room?
boss.explain: 規定寫明「Maximum of four clothing items allowed inside at one time」（一次最多帶四件衣物），故選 A。(B)、(C)、(D) 數量錯誤。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Notice on Office Printer] Color printing costs $5 per page and requires manager approval. For daily office work, please set your default printer mode to black-and-white.
Q: What should employees do for daily office printing?
options: A. Pay $5 in cash each time.
D. Use the machine at the bookstore.
boss.explain: 告示提醒日常辦公列印「please set your default printer mode to black-and-white」（請將預設設為黑白列印），故選 B。(A) 是彩色影印需經主管核准；(C)、(D) 未提及。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Coffee Shop Menu Board] Afternoon Tea Combo (14:00-17:00): Any warm drink with a slice of carrot cake for $160. Add $30 to upgrade your drink to a seasonal strawberry smoothie.
Q: How much does the combo cost if you upgrade the drink to a strawberry smoothie?
boss.explain: 下午茶組合原價 160 元，升級草莓冰沙加價 30 元（Add $30），總計 160 + 30 = 190 元，故選 C。(A)、(B)、(D) 計算有誤。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Weekend Sports Class Notice] Yoga in the Park: Every Sunday morning from 7:30 to 8:30 on the Sun Lawn. Please bring your own yoga mat and towel. If it rains, the class will move to Activity Hall 2.
Q: Where will the yoga class be held if it rains on Sunday morning?
boss.explain: 雨天備案載明「If it rains, the class will move to Activity Hall 2」，故遇雨改在活動二館，選 D。(A) 晴天草坪場地；(B)、(C) 未提及。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Text Message Chain] Kelly: 'Hi Anna, did you get the tickets for the musical this evening?' Anna: 'Yes, I have two tickets for Row 5. The show starts at 7:30 p.m. Let's meet at the theater gate at 7:00.'
Q: Where will Kelly and Anna meet this evening?
boss.explain: Anna 提到碰面地點「Let's meet at the theater gate at 7:00」（在劇院大門口見面），故選 A。(B) 是座位排數；(C)、(D) 未提及。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Apartment Trash Policy] Kitchen food waste must be placed in the brown container before 9:00 p.m. daily. Plastic bottles and cardboard boxes should be folded and placed in the green recycling bins on Saturday mornings.
Q: Which container is used for kitchen food waste?
boss.explain: 規定明確指出「Kitchen food waste must be placed in the brown container」（廚餘必須放入棕色容器），故選 B。(C) 是週六回收塑膠瓶與紙箱的綠色桶；(A)、(D) 未提及。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[School Field Trip Notice] Annual Zoo Trip: This Friday, buses leave the school gate at 8:30 a.m. and return at 3:30 p.m. Students should pack their own lunch and wear the school sports uniform.
Q: What should students wear for the zoo trip?
boss.explain: 通知提醒學生當天穿著「wear the school sports uniform」（穿學校運動制服），故選 C。(A)、(B)、(D) 皆不符合規定著裝。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Weather Station Alert] Cold Surge Warning: Temperatures will drop to 10°C tonight in the northern plains. Strong winds will continue until tomorrow noon. Please keep warm and close all north-facing windows.
Q: What should residents do tonight according to the alert?
options: D. Keep warm and close windows.
boss.explain: 警報文末具體叮嚀「Please keep warm and close all north-facing windows」（請做好保暖並關閉朝北窗戶），故選 D。(A)、(B)、(C) 均違反避寒防風安全指引。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Community Center Timetable] Morning Yoga: Tuesday & Thursday, 09:00-10:00. English Speaking Club: Wednesday, 19:00-20:30. Weekend Cooking Class: Saturday, 14:00-16:00.
Q: When can a person attend the English Speaking Club?
boss.explain: 時程表顯示「English Speaking Club: Wednesday, 19:00-20:30」，19:00 為晚間，故為週三晚上，選 C。(A)、(B) 是瑜伽課；(D) 是烹飪課。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Workplace Email] Dear Staff, our company will hold the monthly meeting on November 12 at 10:00 a.m. in Meeting Room B. Please bring your sales reports. If you cannot attend, please email Mr. Brown before November 10.
Q: What should an employee do if they cannot come to the meeting?
options: A. Call the meeting room directly.
B. Post a notice on the wall.
D. Email Mr. Brown before Nov 10.
boss.explain: 信件最後說明「If you cannot attend, please email Mr. Brown before November 10.」，無法出席者需在此日前發郵件告知，選 D。(A)、(B)、(C) 皆不符合信件指示。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Alishan] Hi Peter, greeting from Alishan! We woke up at 4:30 a.m. today to watch the sunrise, but it was too foggy and we could not see the sun. However, the mountain forest walk this afternoon was really wonderful! See you soon, Sam.
Q: Why couldn't Sam see the sunrise this morning?
options: B. He woke up too late.
D. He stayed inside the hotel.
boss.explain: 明信片中寫道「it was too foggy and we could not see the sun」（霧太大以致看不到太陽），故選 A。(B) 他們早上 4:30 就起床了；(C)、(D) 與內文不符。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Apartment Notice] Water Supply Notice: The water pipe will be repaired on Thursday from 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. There will be no tap water during this period. Please store enough water in advance for cooking and washing.
Q: What will happen on Thursday afternoon?
options: A. The building elevator will stop.
B. There will be no tap water.
C. The front gate will be locked.
D. The electricity will be turned off.
boss.explain: 公告指出週四下午修水管期間「There will be no tap water during this period」（這段期間沒有自來水），故選 B。(A)、(C)、(D) 文中均未提及。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Text Message Chain] Amanda: 'Hi Kevin, is the air conditioner in Room 301 working? It is 34 degrees outside today.' Kevin: 'No, it is broken. The engineer will come tomorrow morning. Please move your students to Room 305.'
Q: Why should Amanda move her students to Room 305?
options: C. The air conditioner in 301 is broken.
boss.explain: Kevin 回覆「No, it is broken... Please move your students to Room 305.」，301 教室冷氣壞掉且外頭高達 34 度，因此需要換教室，選 C。(A)、(B)、(D) 皆非換教室原因。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Cooking School Class Rules] Welcome to our beginners' baking class. Please wash your hands before touching any flour. Wear your clean apron at all times. Long hair must be tied back neatly.
Q: What must students with long hair do in the baking class?
options: D. Tie their hair back neatly.
boss.explain: 烘焙班規定最後一條指明「Long hair must be tied back neatly.」（長髮必須整齊綁起），故選 D。(A)、(B)、(C) 均非規定內容。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Coffee Shop Stamp Card] Buy one coffee to collect one stamp. Collect 10 stamps to get a free drink or a piece of cheesecake! Note: Stamps cannot be exchanged for cash.
Q: What can a customer get after collecting 10 stamps?
options: A. A free drink or cheesecake.
C. A free coffee cup to take home.
boss.explain: 集點卡說明指出集滿 10 點可兌換「a free drink or a piece of cheesecake」（免費飲料一杯或起司蛋糕一塊），故選 A。(B) 註明不能兌換現金；(C)、(D) 未提及。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Museum Floor Guide] 1st Floor: Ancient History & Gift Shop. 2nd Floor: Traditional Asian Art. 3rd Floor: Modern Painting & Café. Restrooms are located on every floor next to the elevator.
Q: On which floor can a visitor find both modern paintings and a café?
boss.explain: 導覽指出三樓配置為「3rd Floor: Modern Painting & Café」，因此現代畫作與咖啡廳均在三樓，選 B。(A) 一樓是古代歷史與禮品店；(C) 二樓是傳統亞洲藝術；(D) 未列出地下室。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Holiday Camping Sign] Welcome to Green Valley Campsite. Quiet hours are from 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. Open fires on the grass are strictly forbidden. Please throw your garbage into the marked bins near the gate.
Q: What is strictly forbidden at this campsite?
options: C. Open fires on the grass.
boss.explain: 營區告示明確指出「Open fires on the grass are strictly forbidden.」（草地上嚴禁生明火），故選 C。(A)、(B)、(D) 未被列為嚴格禁止之事項。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Notice at Subway Station Gate] Attention passengers: Elevator 2 is under maintenance today. Passengers with wheelchairs or baby strollers please use Elevator 1 near Exit 4.
Q: Which elevator should people with baby strollers use today?
boss.explain: 告示指引推嬰兒車或輪椅的乘客「please use Elevator 1 near Exit 4」，故選 D。(A) 2 號電梯保養中故障；(B)、(C) 未提及且輪椅不適宜走樓梯。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：一千
boss.explain: 口說表達「THOUSAND」(num.)：一千。例句：The bicycle costs one thousand dollars.（這輛腳踏車要價一千元。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：便宜的
boss.explain: 口說表達「CHEAP」(n.)：便宜的。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這星期二早上
boss.explain: 口說表達「THIS TUESDAY MORNING」(phr.)：這星期二早上。

boss.desc: 請唸出：在公車站牌那裡
boss.explain: 口說表達「AT THE BUS STOP」(phr.)：在公車站牌那裡。

boss.desc: 請唸出：需要袋子嗎
boss.explain: 口說表達「DO YOU NEED A BAG」(phr.)：需要袋子嗎。

boss.desc: 請唸出：不客氣；很樂意
boss.explain: 口說表達「YOU ARE VERY WELCOME」(phr.)：不客氣；很樂意。

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：我可以看菜單嗎？
boss.ans: COULD I SEE THE MENU PLEASE
boss.speak: could i see the menu please
boss.explain: 口說表達「COULD I SEE THE MENU PLEASE」(phr.)：請唸出短句：我可以看菜單嗎？。

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：今天的特別推薦是什麼？
boss.explain: 口說表達「WHAT IS THE SPECIAL TODAY」(phr.)：請唸出短句：今天的特別推薦是什麼？。

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：請問你能幫我嗎？
boss.explain: 口說表達「COULD YOU PLEASE HELP ME」(phr.)：請唸出短句：請問你能幫我嗎？。

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：走到那裡只要五分鐘。
boss.ans: IT TAKES FIVE MINUTES TO WALK
boss.speak: it takes five minutes to walk
boss.explain: 口說表達「IT TAKES FIVE MINUTES TO WALK」(phr.)：請唸出短句：走到那裡只要五分鐘。。

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：請問試衣間在哪裡？
boss.explain: 口說表達「WHERE ARE THE FITTING ROOMS」(phr.)：請唸出短句：請問試衣間在哪裡？。

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：這個襯衫太小了。
boss.explain: 口說表達「THIS SHIRT IS TOO SMALL」(phr.)：請唸出短句：這個襯衫太小了。。

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：我可以試穿別的顏色嗎？
boss.explain: 口說表達「CAN I TRY ANOTHER COLOR」(phr.)：請唸出短句：我可以試穿別的顏色嗎？。

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：我們星期四下午見面吧。
boss.ans: LET US MEET ON THURSDAY AFTERNOON
boss.speak: let us meet on thursday afternoon
boss.explain: 口說表達「LET US MEET ON THURSDAY AFTERNOON」(phr.)：請唸出短句：我們星期四下午見面吧。。

boss.desc: 【職場文法】My friend and I ___ in this bank.
boss.explain: My friend and I ___ in this bank. 主詞是「我朋友和我」，為複數（等於 We），所以動詞不用加 -s，直接用原形 work。

boss.desc: 【生活文法】There ___ some milk on the table.
boss.explain: There ___ some milk on the table. milk（牛奶）是不可數名詞，必須視為單數，因此搭配 is。

boss.desc: 【旅遊文法】You ___ park your bicycle here.
boss.explain: You ___ park your bicycle here. 助動詞 can 的否定是 cannot 或 can't，不能用 do not 加上 can。

boss.desc: 【職場字彙】The clerk writes and sends many ___ to the boss every day.
boss.explain: The clerk sends many ___ to the boss. 店員發送給老闆的通常是 emails（電子郵件）。

boss.desc: 【生活文法】___ birds are there in the park?
boss.explain: ___ birds are there in the park? birds 是可數名詞複數，問數量要用 How many。

boss.desc: 【旅遊對話】A: How do you go to school? B: I go there ___ foot.
boss.explain: A: How do you go there? B: I go there ___ foot. 表達「走路、步行」固定用法是 on foot。

boss.desc: 【職場對話】A: Is this desk yours? B: Yes, it is ___.
boss.explain: A: Is this desk yours? B: Yes, it is ___. 空格前是 be 動詞，表示「它是我的（辦公桌）」，需用所有格代名詞 mine。

boss.desc: 【生活文法】When the taxi ___, we can go to the movies.
boss.explain: When the taxi ___, we can go to the movie. 條件子句的主詞 taxi 是單數，動詞需加 -s，選 arrives。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Email] Hello, the new desk is too big for my room. I want to put it in the hall. Can you help me move it at 15:00?
Q: Why does the writer want to move the desk?
options: B. It is too big for the room.
C. The hall is too small.
D. He wants to buy a new one.
boss.explain: 信中提到「the new desk is too big for my room.（新桌子對我的房間來說太大了）」，這是想移動桌子的原因。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Sign] Parking: Cars $50/hour, Taxis $30/hour. Bicycles are free.
Q: How much does it cost to park a bicycle?
boss.explain: 告示寫著「Bicycles are free.（腳踏車免費）」，因此費用是 0 元。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Note] Mom, I took the cat to the animal hospital. I will be back before dinner. Please feed the bird.
Q: What should the mother do?
boss.explain: 便條最後寫「Please feed the bird.（請餵鳥）」，這是要求媽媽做的事情。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Ad] Singer Lily's new movie is in theaters today. Watch it at 18:00 or 20:00.
Q: What is Lily's new work about?
boss.explain: 廣告提到「Singer Lily's new movie is in theaters today.（歌手 Lily 的新電影今天上映）」，所以是新電影。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Schedule] Driver Wang: 09:00 Bank, 11:00 Park, 14:00 Office, 16:00 Store.
Q: Where is Driver Wang at 10:00?
options: A. He is at the store.
B. He is at the office.
C. He is probably at the bank or going to the park.
D. He is at the park.
boss.explain: 9:00在銀行，11:00在公園，所以10:00時他應該還在銀行或是前往公園的路上。選項C最符合邏輯。（A、B、D皆不合時間）

boss.desc: 【家庭文法】My cousin and his wife ___ a beautiful house near the park.
boss.explain: 本題測試主詞與動詞一致。主詞為 My cousin and his wife，是兩個人（複數），因此動詞需使用原形 have，故選 D。

boss.desc: 【食物文法】How ___ sugar do you want in your tea?
boss.explain: 本題測試數量形容詞。sugar（糖）是不可數名詞，詢問數量時必須搭配 How much，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【購物文法】The black shirt is nice, but I want to look at the blue ___.
boss.explain: 本題測試代名詞。這裡代替前面提過的單數名詞 shirt（襯衫），需使用不定代名詞 one，故選 D。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Shopping List] Things to buy: 1. A box of rice 2. Three potatoes 3. A bottle of oil 4. Some fresh fish. Do not buy any cheese because we still have a lot.
Q: Which item is NOT on the shopping list?
boss.explain: 本題測試短文細節。清單上明確指示「Do not buy any cheese」（不要買起司），代表它不在此次購買清單中，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【學校文法】Everyone in the school ___ listening to the principal right now.
boss.explain: 本題測試不定代名詞的單複數。Everyone（每個人）在文法上視為單數，搭配進行式時，需使用 be 動詞 is，故選 D。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Library Notice] Welcome to the Town Library. Books can be borrowed for 14 days. DVDs can be borrowed for 7 days. If you return items late, you must pay 5 dollars for each day.
Q: How long can a person keep a DVD?
boss.explain: 本題測試短文細節搜尋。告示牌中提到「DVDs can be borrowed for 7 days.」（DVD 可借 7 天），故選 B。

boss.desc: 【季節對話】A: Which season do you like? B: I like ___, because I enjoy seeing the beautiful flowers.
boss.explain: 本題測試季節字彙與語境推論。回答者提到喜歡看美麗的花朵，花朵通常在春季盛開，故選 A (春天)。

boss.desc: 【季節文法】In Taiwan, the air ___ very hot and humid in summer.
boss.explain: 本題測試現在簡單式。主詞 the air 為不可數名詞，視為第三人稱單數，動詞需加 s，故選 D。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Travel Blog] We visited Kyoto last autumn. The red and brown leaves were stunning. It was a bit cold, but we had a great time visiting the old temples.
Q: When did the writer visit Kyoto?
boss.explain: 本題測試短文細節。第一句話提到「We visited Kyoto last autumn.」（我們去年秋天拜訪了京都），故選 B。

boss.desc: 【動物對話】A: Are those bears dangerous? B: Yes, ___ are. Please stay away from them.
boss.explain: 本題測試主格代名詞。代替前面提過的複數名詞 those bears，在答句中擔任主詞，需使用 they，故選 A。

boss.desc: 【顏色對話】A: What color is your new car? B: It is ___, just like the dark night.
boss.explain: 本題測試顏色字彙。後句提示「就像黑夜一樣」，黑夜的顏色為黑色（black），故選 A。

boss.desc: 【動物文法】There are three ___ sleeping under the tall tree.
boss.explain: 本題測試不規則複數名詞。綿羊（sheep）的單複數同形，前面有 three 時，仍維持 sheep，不加 s，故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Farm Poster] Come to Happy Farm this weekend! You can ride a pony, feed the ducks, and pick fresh tomatoes. The price is 100 dollars for adults and 50 dollars for children under twelve.
Q: How much is the cost for a man and his ten-year-old son?
boss.explain: 本題測試短文資訊統整。成人票 100 元，十二歲以下孩童票 50 元。一位成年男子與他十歲的兒子總共是 100 + 50 = 150 元，故選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文理解】[Zoo Sign] Welcome to the Lion Zone. Please stay behind the red line. Do not feed the lions. They sleep a lot, so please do not make loud sounds.
Q: What should visitors NOT do?
options: B. Stay behind the red line
C. Give food to the lions
boss.explain: 本題測試短文細節。告示牌明確規定「Do not feed the lions.」（不要餵食獅子），give food 即為 feed 的同義代換，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文理解】[Note] Hi Tom, your blue shirt is on the bed. Your black shoes are in the box. Dad. Q: Where are the black shoes?
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試細節讀取。文中清楚提到「Your black shoes are in the box.（你的黑鞋子在箱子裡）」，因此選項 D 為正確答案。藍色襯衫才是在床上（A）。

boss.desc: 【短文理解】[Note] I have a new apartment. It has one bedroom and a small bathroom. There is no TV in it. Q: What is NOT in the apartment?
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試否定訊息的理解。文章寫到「There is no TV in it.（裡面沒有電視）」，所以公寓裡沒有的東西是電視。臥室與浴室都有在文中被提及。

boss.desc: 【短文理解】[Diary] My house is very clean. The desk is near the door. My red hat is under the desk. Q: Where is the desk?
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試相對位置的理解。日記提到「The desk is near the door.（書桌在門附近）」，故選 B。紅帽子是在書桌下，而不是書桌在帽子下（A）。

boss.desc: 【短文理解】[Profile] Name: Leo. Pet: A small mouse. His mouse likes to eat cheese. It sleeps in a box. Q: What does the mouse like to eat?
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試短文理解。從寵物檔案中可以看到「His mouse likes to eat cheese.（他的老鼠喜歡吃起司）」，因此答案是起司。其他食物未被提及。

boss.desc: 【短文理解】[Text] Hi Jane, can you feed my fish? They are in the glass bowl. Give them food at night. Q: When should Jane feed the fish?
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試時間細節。簡訊中指示「Give them food at night.（在晚上給牠們食物）」，因此餵魚的時間是晚上。選項 C 完全符合文章資訊。

boss.desc: 【短文理解】[Email] Dear Ken, I have a new dog. His name is Max. He is brown and very strong. He likes to run in the park. Q: What color is the dog?
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試基本形容詞（顏色）讀取。郵件裡提到這隻狗是「He is brown（他是棕色的）」，所以答案選 D。其他顏色都不正確。

boss.desc: 【短文理解】[Shop Sign] Breakfast Set: Bread and milk for 50 dollars. Salad and tea for 60 dollars. Q: How much is the salad and tea?
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試價格資訊的配對。告示牌寫道「Salad and tea for 60 dollars（沙拉和茶賣 60 元）」，所以答案是 60 元。50 元是麵包加牛奶的價格。

boss.desc: 【短文理解】[Note] Dad, I do not want rice for lunch. I want some noodles and fish. I will come back at twelve. Q: What does the writer want for lunch?
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試食物細節。作者明確表示不要米飯（do not want rice），而是要「some noodles and fish（一些麵條和魚肉）」，所以答案選 A。

boss.desc: 【短文理解】[Note] Please clean the fruit. Put the tomatoes on the table. Do not put them in the box. Q: Where do the tomatoes go?
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試指令理解。紙條說「Put the tomatoes on the table.（把番茄放在桌上）」，並且強調不要放進箱子裡。因此正確位置是桌上（B）。

boss.desc: 【短文理解】[Email] Hi Mary, I am in the town. The shops are very nice. I want to buy a hat. Bye. Q: What does the writer want to buy?
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試購物意圖。郵件中清楚寫出「I want to buy a hat.（我想買一頂帽子）」，因此直接對應選項 C。其餘物品並未提及。

boss.desc: 【短文理解】[Schedule] Town Bus Route: 08:00 Bank, 08:15 Park, 08:30 School, 08:45 Store. Q: Where is the bus at 08:30?
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試時間表查閱能力。根據時刻表，08:30 對應的地點是 School（學校），所以巴士當時在學校（D）。銀行是 08:00，商店是 08:45。

boss.desc: 【短文理解】[Note] We have a movie club on the weekend. We watch old movies. It is free for students. Q: Who can watch for free?
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試特定對象的優惠條件。紙條寫「It is free for students.（對學生免費）」，因此只有學生可以免費觀看。老師、司機和醫生均未提及。

boss.desc: 【短文理解】[Diary] May 5. I read a good book at home. Then I played a video game with my friend. We had a lot of fun. Q: What did the writer do after reading a book?
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此題測試事件的先後順序。作者寫道在家看完好書後（Then），「played a video game（玩了電動遊戲）」，所以讀書後做的事是玩遊戲（B）。
